event-75160328.21: I hope they get to rebuild their lives soon.$s
event-75160328.22: Oh, and I just wanted to say how much I appreciate you for always going along with whatever I'm up to.#$b#I always thought I'm messy company, someone who's always busy with an erratic schedule.$s#$b#But you stuck by me and extended your aid to me and my endeavors as well, especially to the people in need.$l#$b#You're awesome, @!$h#$b#Grazie! Thank you for always being there!$h
event-75160328.24: Kiarra seems content, but she won't be slowing down any time soon.
event-75160328.25: I wish the best for them! Thank you for helping out, @.$h
event-75160328.KiarraDisappointed.02: I guess I better find other people to ask if they're willing to help, Lenny.$s
kiarra8_choice1: I knew I could count on you!$h
kiarra8_choice2: Oh, uh... Yeah, it's fine. I understand.$s%fork
event-grandmaMessage.1: My dear grandchild...#I'm glad that you've finally come...#I'm sure your grandfather is too...#Live well, my dear...
event-75160381.01: Greetings, farmer. You've done well to come here after reading my letter. You are truly one of my most loyal followers.$1#$b#The Foxbloom you procured was most excellent in quality. My beloved was quite overjoyed with the flower I-- you found for her.$1#$b#She used the energy the flower imbued her with to create two symbols of our love for us, and I thought it was only fair for you to have access to them as well.#$b#It may be a bit... intimate, but consider it a token of my gratitude.$1#$b#...And an, *ahem*, incentive to say not a word about the origins of that flower to my beloved.$5#$b#Now, come this way.
event-75160381.02: My loyal follower Jio told you about this ledger, correct? You can use it to obtain goods you may need in your service of the Lady.#$b#I've added the rings my beloved designed to the listings.#$b#While she may be able to create them with her natural power, I need Spiritual Essence in order to manifest these items for you.#$b#That said, as long as you bring the amount of Essence required to the spell book, I will be able to create the ring for you instantly, across time and space.
event-75160381.03: What do these rings do? That, my loyal follower, you must find out for yourself.$1#$b#I believe my explanation should suffice. So long.
FarmKiwi.Jio.1: If Jio here, then Kiwi here, too.
FarmKiwi.Daia.1: Jio send Kiwi. Jio say check on Daia, stab if Daia being fool.
FarmKiwi.2: Kiwi see farmer and %spouse touch lips early in morning. Kiwi think humans are weird and dirty.
FarmKiwi.4: Kiwi help? Kiwi good at helping.
FarmKiwi.5: @ has big hut. Why hut so big when @ so tiny?
FarmKiwi.6: Kiwi hear strange noises from cave... Strange cave.
FarmKiwi.7: Kiwi bored! We leave farm soon?
FarmKiwi.8: When @'s grandma live here, here was much smaller. Kiwi remember.
FarmKiwi.9: Hmm... @ hut is nice, but Kiwi hut smells better.
Raeriyala.FoxbloomHint.0: Are you wondering when the Foxbloom will appear this season, oh farmer? Well, I just so happen to have a riddle that might help you! It goes like this--
Raeriyala.FoxbloomHint.7: "Soft light through the new-grown leaves, a snake goes a-courting with hope. Flowers for each sun of a week's passing, and her beloved blooms at last."
Raeriyala.FoxbloomHint.14: "The deep warmth of the midday sun, lazy days curled together with fond hearts. A dozen and two full to the brim with love, and her beloved blooms at last."
Raeriyala.FoxbloomHint.21: "Brisk winds stir the amber grass, joyful words of lively village gathering. The moon descends and the next sun rises, and her beloved blooms at last."
Raeriyala.FoxbloomHint.28: "Quiet glimmer of moonlit snow, sheltered within a fox's fur. Fiery resolution warms the heart, and her beloved blooms at last."
Raeriyala.FoxbloomHint.1: I hope that can be of some help to you!$1

Sean.construction.1: Ugh, this kind of work is the worst. I hate sitting here hammering nails all day...$2#$b#But, of course, I would never let that affect my performance! I'm just tired from how hard I've been working, haha!$1
Sean.construction.2: How's the work going? Well, you could say we're nailing it!$1#$e#Oh shoot, am I holding this thing upside down?$3

Blair.MarriageDialogue.spring_1: Hey, babe!#$b#Would you like some help with spring cleaning at home?
Blair.MarriageDialogue.spring_12: There's gonna be tons of eggs tomorrow!$h#$b#What do you think about having an egg fight after the egg hunt?$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.spring_23: Sooooooo, how does it feel to take the most beautiful girl to the dance tomorrow?$6#$b#You must be thanking the mountain spirit right now.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.summer_1: Hot girl summer! Woohoo!$h#$b#We should make beach plans, babe.#$b#It would be such a waste if we kept our hotness to ourselves. That would be cruel to the rest of the valley.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.summer_10: Watch out for my outfit tomorrow, babe.#$b#I'll make your jaw drop.$4#$b#Maybe I can show you my hula moves, too... however bad they may be, hehe.$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.summer_27: Hey, babe? Maybe we could pack a picnic blanket tomorrow?#$b#We could lay down and watch the stars while waiting for the jellies to arrive.$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.fall_1: Fall, ech.$u#$b#This season usually means sweeping every day.$u#$e#The only good thing about it, though, is that it's breezier than summer.$h#$b#Which means more hugs!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.fall_15: We should make a game plan for what to do tomorrow.#$b#Should we separate and cover more ground, like divide-and-conquer? Or should we team up and take them on together?$7
Blair.MarriageDialogue.fall_19: Are you excited about tomorrow, babe?#$b#People will definitely be asking us about a lot of things. Especially newlywed stuff... If ya know what I mean.$9
Blair.MarriageDialogue.fall_26: What are you going to dress as tomorrow, babe?#$b#We could dress as 'Bobbie and Clyve'! Flor was mumbling about this couple who's so iconic they made a book about them!$h#$b#We'd be the talk of the town!$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.winter_1: Brr, winter is the best season for hot chocolate!$h#$b#And lots of cuddles!$4#$b#And last but not the least, SNOWBALL FIGHTS!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.winter_7: I've been thinking about what better baits there are to use for the festival of ice tomorrow.$7#$b#The competition really gets me riled up!$h#$b#We have to show them we're the best, babe!$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.winter_24: I know it's a tradition to make a wish tomorrow.#$b#But honestly... What more could I wish for?$6#$b#I'm already so happy with you and I feel content with everything that we have in our life right now.$4
I did a good job decorating the room, didn't I?#$b#I think I could help Kiarra and Anton whenever they have a gig.$h#$e#Yes, I think I'm that good, babe!$7#$b#Why? Are you going to disagree?$h

I've been wanting to get my own little nook since I was younger.#$b#I love what I did with this room because it doesn't look too "fishy", you know?$h#$e#On a serious note though, I like that I get to be able to do things on my own.$h#$b#And also with you, of course!$4

We should get some board games, babe.$h#$b#Ooh, and also sets of cards!$h#$b#That way we could play bets on who has the more drawings in the face first.$4#$b#I'll give you a wager right now that the one to have the most would be you.$h

Hmm, babe. Do you think the room's too purpley-pinkish?$u#$b#I just realized that other people might think I'm too chica.$h#$b#It'll be hard to keep my cool reputation if they think that...$h#$e#Oh well, I'm always cool no matter what color my room is!$7

Do you know something, babe?#$b#One thing I appreciate about us is that our conversations can get so random at times, but it feels normal to us.$7#$e#I really think it's cute.$h#$b#I think we're cute!$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.patio_Blair.1: I can't get enough of your face, babe!$4#$b#There's just something about it that makes me want to squish you!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.patio_Blair.2: Hmm, this fishnet...$7#$b#Maybe I could get Faye to make some custom fishnets that have tinier holes. I think it'd catch more fish. Don't you think so too, babe?
Blair.MarriageDialogue.patio_Blair.3: Ah, fresh air!$h#$b#Maybe I could get Corine and Ysa to join me when I try to do yoga for the first time.#$e#That is, if I can get Miss Pretty-Pink Ysa to be around fishes.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.patio_Blair.4: %Blair proceeds to inhale a large amount of air.#$b#Phe-ew.$u#$b#Babe, did you fart?$u#$e#Haha, kidding! I was just messing with you!$h#$b#I love you, baby!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.patio_Blair.5: Ay dios mio!$u#$b#I almost face-planted into that pail of water!$u#$e#Hehe, I guess I'm a little clumsy.$4#$b#I'm sorry, baby. I'll watch my step next time.$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_0: Rain, rain, go away!$h#$b#Just kidding, I love the rain.$h#$e#It's kind of weird for me to enjoy rain though because fishes are hard to find whenever it's raining.#$b#But I still enjoy it.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_1: Man, it's really coming down out here.$7#$b#I hope the fishes don't hide too much.$s
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_2: Ayayay, wet wet wet.$u#$b#Craaaazy rain, ayayay.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_3: I want to take a shower in the rain, baby.$6#$b#What do you say? Let's go out and take a shower on our patio?$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_4: The good thing about rainy days is that it's not scorching hot.$h#$b#That sun seems so angry these days.$u
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_Blair: Honeybunch sugarpluuuuum!$6#$b#Teehee! Nothing, babe! I just felt like calling you!$4#$b#The rain seems to be making me crazier than normal.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_0: Ooh, you look awfully good while wet, babe.$7#$b#Would you like to continue whatever it is you're doing at home?$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_1: Damn, babe!$4#$b#It must be a crime to douse you with water!$h#$b#You look awfully good.$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_2: Ugh, I've had enough of this rain.$s#$b#I want to have clear skies already, babe!$u
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_3: I've been thinking about different things to do in the rain...$6#$e#And...$6#$b#I had an idea that will require us both to be in the bedroom.$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_4: Don't you just love how the rain quenches the thirst of the land?$h#$b#But I do hope the fishes don't drown!$7#$b#Haha! Just kidding!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_5: Hmm, babe?#$b#Why don't we come home and just go out when the rain is over?$6#$b#I'm sure we could keep ourselves occupied if we really put our heads together.$4#$e#Or maybe we could occupy ourselves out here in the rain?$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_Blair: Man, it really is raining cats and dogs today.#$e#Teehee, imagine if it really was raining cats and dogs!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_0: Baaaaabe!$h#$e#Hehe, oh nothing! I just enjoy calling you.$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_1: Oh my Yoba! BABE! I just found out that you stole something!$u#$b#You stole my heart!$4#$e#Hehe! I'm just being silly, babe.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_2: Hey, babe?#$b#I've been thinking, do you think fishes talk with their mouths full?#$b#I mean, their mouth is always full of water.$6#$e#Haha! I don't even know why that thought went inside my head.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_3: Random thoughts have been entering my head lately.$7#$b#Like incredibly random out-of-this-world kind of thoughts. Like fishes crawling instead of swimming.$u#$e#It must be a good thing that you love me so much, huh, babe?$4#$b#Or else you might think I'm crazy!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_4: What are you up to today, babe?#$b#Do you need a good luck kiss from the best wife ever?$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_Blair: You must've done something good in your past life, babe.#$b#For you to be so blessed with an amazing wife like me, I think you must have been at least deity-level in the past.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_0: My Yoba, what a day!$u#$b#That was tiring.$s#$b#But boy am I glad to see you, babe!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_1: The farm looks abundant, babe!$h#$b#I'm proud to say that I'm the best good luck charm you have.$h#$e#Haha, just kidding!$h#$b#You've been doing great work on the farm, babe.#$b#You the best!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_2: It's kind of quiet tonight, babe?#$b#Why don't we make some noise of our own...?$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_3: Ugh, I feel so tired, baby.$s#$b#Could we just hug each other on the bed?$s
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_4: Did you finish all your tasks for today, baby?#$e#If you feel tired I could do a 'karate chop' massage for you.$h#$b#Just kidding, babe.$h#$b#I'll be gentle, I promise.$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_Blai: Congratulations, babe!$h#$b#You get to sleep beside the most amazing woman in the valley, me!$h#$b#Haha, isn't it a gift to have me every day and night?$h#$e#Kidding aside though, babe... I feel lucky to be able to come home to my best friend every day.$4#$b#I love you, @.$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_0: What should we do tuh-day, babe?$h#$b#Maybe we could race to the Ridge, if you're not too busy?$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_1: The bees frolicking around the flowers remind me of you, babe.#$b#You're the bee frolicking around me, the pretty little flower.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_2: Could you fetch me some refreshments in your free time, babe?#$b#I'd really enjoy some drinks - along with your company, of course.$h#$b#It would be a great distraction from all the work I have today.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_3: I'm dripping in sweat, babe.$7#$b#But even then, it just makes me look even hotter. Right, babe?$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_4: Hey there, babe.$h#$b#If you happen to stop by at Willy's could you grab a hook for me? I think I misplaced mine.$s
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Blair.2: I'm thinking about fishing on the Ridge today.#$b#I heard there are magical entities that help you there. Maybe I'll find my lucky charm there.#$e#Oh poo, don't feel bad. You're still the best lucky charm that I have. I just have to look for one that's meant for fishing, and fishing only.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Blair.3: Bye, baby!#$b#Don't miss me too much, okay?$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Blair.4: I'm off to the village, babe.#$b#Mom will be loca if I don't visit her every once in a while.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Blair.5: Ayayay, as much as I don't want to leave you... I'm afraid the fishes will miss me.$s#$b#So hang tight, baby. I'll be back later, okay?$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Blair.1: What's up, ketchup?#$b#Did you miss me, baby?$h#$e#I hope you did because I'm going to cuddle you so hard when we get to bed!$h#$b#That is, after I freshen up.$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Blair.2: Welcome home, babe!#$b#Miss me?$4#$e#I had the craziest day today!$s#$b#I really need a hug.$s
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Blair.3: How was your day, babe?#$b#I missed you!#$e#Oh, by the way, Trinnie and Keahi said the farm looked beautiful.$h#$b#They said they wanted to visit soon. Should we spend the day with them next time and give them a tour of the land?
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Blair.4: Ayayay, what a day!$7#$b#The best thing about coming home here is that I get to see your big face, babe!$h#$b#Haha, I love you!$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Blair.5: I'm back, babe!$h#$b#Phew, what's that smell?$u#$b#Babe, you smell like...#$b#Like someone in looooove.$4#$e#Haha, got you there, didn't I?$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_0: Ayayay, I fear our little one might take after me.$u#$b#If so, we might have our hands full with this one.$7
Blair.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_1: Having a kid is something I didn't really see myself doing before.#$b#With all the stuff that happened to me before, I just thought bringing a kid into the world would be eh.#$b#But because of you, babe. I'm honestly enjoying motherhood.$4#$b#Thank you for coming into my life, babe.$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_2: Look at our little baby, @!$h#Our baby looks so cute, right?$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_3: Hey babe, do you wanna play a prank on our little love?$h#$b#We could hide when the %kid1 is not looking then wait till tears form %kid1's eyes then pop out!$h#$e#Ackk, is that too mean?$u
Blair.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_0: Ay dios mio, I just hope that these two don't take after me.$u#$b#If they do, our hands will definitely be full.$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_1: They're both so cute!$h#$b#We produce quite the offspring.$4#$b#It's like they won the genetic lottery!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_2: Hey, baby? Who do you love more, me or the kids?#$b#Haha! Just kidding, I just wanted to see you sweat because of the question, babe.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_3: Awww, the kids look so happy.$h#$b#Maybe we could arrange a playdate with Sean, Keahi, and Trinnie!$h#$b#It'll be like the gang's back together, babe!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_0: What's up, my little bubble of happiness?$h#$b#I've been feeling a bit chipper today, would you like to do a happy dance with me?$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_1: I don't know what I did in my past life, but I sure am glad to have done something enough to deserve you, baby.$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_2: There are just some things that are super special which deserve to be shared with the world.#$b#One of those is you, @.$6#$b#Teehee.$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_3: You know what, babe? I've been thinking about making a treehouse.#$b#The kids would love it if we have one that would be open for everyone!$h#$b#We could even play hide and seek together!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_4: Babe, what do you think about making a fort?$h#$b#I saw a fort-making contest video yesterday, and I've been thinking about it ever since!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_5: Haha! Babe, I can't stop laughing!$h#$b#Keahi played the funniest prank on Sean!$h#$b#He cut Sean's trousers around the back so it looked like it has two buttholes!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_6: I've been thinking about pitter-patter of little feet, babe.$6#$b#What do you say about making a home addition?$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_7: Babe!$u#$b#I lost something!$u#$b#But then I found you. Hihi!$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_8: Hey, babe!#$b#Did it hurt?$7#$b#Did it hurt when you fell from heaven to save me?$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_9: Babe, can you stop?$u#$b#You've been running on my mind since the day we met! Aren't you tired?$6

Paula.MarriageDialogue.spring_1: Do you smell the fresh air, darling?#$b#Spring is here!$h

Paula.MarriageDialogue.fall_15: We should organize our route for tomorrow's fair, @.#$b#I think it would be the best strategy and that way we could also check the welfare of everyone who attended.$9#$e#Hehe, I'm sorry. The doctor in me is on duty almost every time.$8
Paula.MarriageDialogue.fall_19: I'm quite excited for tomorrow, darling.$h#$b#We get to catch up with everybody and talk about our lives.#$b#It'll be like a mini-reunion.$h#$e#You know, before you came to town it was just the same old different stories...$7#$b#Now that you're here, everything seems so lively and new again.$h#$b#You really bring brightness with you, my darling.$4
Paula.MarriageDialogue.fall_26: What costume do you think will look best on me, @?#$b#I feel like dressing up for tomorrow.$4

Paula.MarriageDialogue.winter_7: We have to be sure to bring an extra-hot thermos tomorrow.$6#$b#Everyone, especially the elderly, might need it. So it's better to come prepared.$9#$e#But also, good luck on your ice fishing competition tomorrow, my darling!$h#$b#Bring home the sushi!$h
Paula.MarriageDialogue.winter_24: It's almost the end of the year, @. What are you most thankful for?$4#$b#I do hope that I was able to make your year a little better, because you certainly made my year the best.$8

Paula.MarriageDialogue.patio_Paula.5: Lola taught me a little trick once.#$b#She said the best way to a person's heart is to beat the jeepers out of them in drinking.$h#$b#Now you know why I challenged you back then.$4

Paula.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_3: One thing I like about the rain is that it's a great excuse to eat spicy food.$h#$b#Be a very sweet and loving spouse, darling, and bring me home something spicy from Pika's please?$4
Paula.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_4: Can you give me a hug, @?#$b#Oh, nothing, I just wanted a warm hug from you before I go.$4

Paula.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_3: My, that was an exhausting day!$u#$b#Can we just cuddle and sleep the whole night?$s
Paula.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_4: I heard you've been exploring quite a bit today, darling.#$b#Did you drink water throughout the day like I told you?

Paula.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_4: What's my little adventurer up to now?#$b#Alright, just make sure to be safe. I love you!$h

Paula.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Paula.4: Have a great day ahead, my darling.#$b#I'll see you when I get home, okay?$h

Paula.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Paula.2: Welcome home to us, my darling!$h#$b#Have you been getting your daily exercise?#$b#You're looking particularly... good today.$4#$b#Maybe we should... take our bonding time to the bedroom after we change?$4

Paula.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Paula.5: The best part of comingh home is seeing your beautiful face, @.$8#$b#I've been missing that smudge-face since this morning.$9#$b#Hehe, it might be a little cheesy for our taste, but I don't know why I can't stop myself from getting giddy over you.$4

Paula.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_2: Thank you, @.$4#$b#I know there was a lot going on when we first met...$8#$b#And despite my shortcomings and my issues, you were and still are being patient with me.$9#$b#And not to mention, the kids.$8#$b#You gave me and the kids a beautiful and happy life. Thank you, my darling.$4

Paula.MarriageDialogue.Good_1: It's amazing how time flies so fast, right, darling?$8#$b#It's like the years have sped by and we're going to grow old together soon.$9

MapString.rsv.aguarbasement4: Assorted Notes on Magical Creatures.#From Grand Witch Bel, to my apprentice.#It's bookmarked on a page on mermaids...#It reads...#'If a mermaid was kept out of the water for far too long, despite being able to breathe oxygen, they slowly but gradually start to present varying symptoms of delirium or derangement, spiraling into inevitable insanity unless returned home.'
GuestDialogue.1: Guest: Why can't I visit the balcony?#I demand to talk to the manager!
GuestDialogue.2: Guest: You're a farmer? Wow! That's cool.#So... Why are you here now? On vacation?#I sure hope you're not slacking off.
GuestDialogue.3: Guest: Why are the locals in this village all so pretty?#There was this red-headed cutie...#Then a brunette hottie...#Why!?
GuestDialogue.4: Guest: I saw a rolling kiwi fruit while being shown around the village.#I wasn't that surprised though. There's a lot of farms in the area, anyway.#It must've belonged to one of them, right?
GuestDialogue.5: Guest: Excuse me, do I know you?#Then why are you talking to me?#Stranger danger! Hello!? Duh!
GuestDialogue.6: Guest: I just came from the hotel's gym. Phew! That was a nice workout!#Some guy was teaching other people about how to achieve proper form. It was cool.
GuestDialogue.7: Guest: Does this place have centralized air conditioning?#It feels cold, but... I don't see any big machine or whatever!#Don't tell me... There's magic!?
GuestDialogue.8: Guest: I saw this weird kid earlier smiling at me.#He approached me then just gave me a pat at the back.#ACHOO! Excuse me. I think I got a whiff of something bad.#Anyway, yeah. Watch out for that weird kid.
GuestDialogue.9: Guest: What do you want? What's with the funny look?#Wanna fight? Come on! You asked for it!
GuestDialogue.10: Guest: I forgot to charge my camera's batteries!#Oh man! I was looking forward to taking a picture by the waterfalls.
GuestDialogue.11: Guest: I'm here to visit the Mountain Spirit Shrine.#I heard so much about the legends that surround it.#It's really interesting!
GuestDialogue.12: Guest: Huh? Did you know that this giant village used to be a huge mining village?#Or maybe it was somewhere near here.#Meh! I think I mixed stuff up.
GuestDialogue.13: Guest: Yo! That Pika's Restaurant has some lit meals, on Yoba!#Dang! I'd like to get some more take-out!#Got any spare change I can borrow?
GuestDialogue.14: Guest: The cable car ride was quite scary, but the view from this place is worth it!#The waterfalls all around make a lot of noise, though.
GuestDialogue.15: Guest: The festivals here are both cute and scary.#Cute because they seem wholesome!#Scary because they could easily end up in a food fight.#And the other involves fire!
GuestDialogue.16: Guest: I wonder where my coin purse went....#I swear I had it just earlier!#Ugh! Are there any pickpockets in this village!?#This sucks!
GuestDialogue.17: Guest: What's the deal with that mysterious guy at the Ridge?#He just came out of nowhere telling us to stay away from the forest up north!#Rude!
GuestDialogue.18: Guest: This village is fine, I guess.#But you know what could be better?#Huge parties at night.#This place is too tame!
GuestDialogue.19: Guest: Why are you talking to me?#Are you some kind of a creep or something?#Weirdo.
GuestDialogue.20: Guest: I saw a chicken walking around town earlier.#I guess you could say that chicken was free from society's yoke.#Kinda crazy.#I also saw this turtle by the pond.#It bit me though, so that was also kinda crazy.#Ka-ka-ka-krazy, I tell ya.
MapString.rsv.eggfest.1: This chicken isn't free from society's yoke.
event-75160311.01: Oh, hey @!$h#$b#It's a good day for fishing, don't you think?

event-75160312.12: @?... I'm sorry you had to see that...$s#$b#I'm really childish, aren't I?$s

Maybe?$s#$b#Was I the reason my family fell apart?$s#$b#I know my mom had me when she was quite young...$s#$b#Maybe I stole their youth from them?$s#$b#Maybe? event-75160405.01: ...and these progress notes are almost done.#$b#Phew!$h
event-75160405.02: Hah! Look at you! You big busy-bee.#$b#You still have so much work to do even without any patients around, huh?$h
event-75160405.03: Anton?$4#$b#Hey! I thought you're helping out Ian and Sean now?$h#$b#They're usually so busy, what are you doing here?#$b#Don't tell me you're cutting work!$6
event-75160405.04: I'll have you know that I'm on break.$h#$b#Woah! It feels weird being able to say that now.$6#$b#You know, being unemployed for so long.$h
event-75160405.05: And now, look at you! See? I knew you could do it.$h#$b#Yeah...$l
event-75160405.09: Oh! Yeah! I forgot about that!$h#$b#Here!$h
event-75160405.10: I bought us some drinks!$h#$b#I actually ordered some food at Pika's, but he said it'll take a while.#$b#So I told him to have someone deliver it here instead!#$b#I think it's a good thing though, because the restaurant is full of tourists today!$u#$b#At least here, you can relax for a bit.#$b#I know you've been working hard, Paw.$h
event-75160405.11: You shouldn't have! Silly!$8#$b#Don't tell me you had it delivered so I can cover the bill?$l#$b#Admit it!$l
event-75160405.12: Hey! I'll have you know I have a paycheck now!$h#$b#So this is on me, doc.$l
event-75160405.13: Wow! Look at mister moneybucks here!$h#$b#Haha! For real though, thank you.
event-75160405.18: Nah! Your gulps were louder! Are you sure you know how to drink?$h
event-75160405.19: Um...$l#$b#Hey... Thanks for this.$l#$b#I needed this break.$h
event-75160405.20: Anytime, Paw!$h#$b#And, um... Well...#$b#I was just wondering...$6#$b#Are you free tomorrow?$6
event-75160405.23: *ahem* I'm sorry about that!$9#$b#But yeah, I'm free tomorrow. Why do you ask, Ton?$l
event-75160405.24: Nothing! Well... I was just wondering if you want...$6#$b#If you want to stroll around the valley with me?$l#$b#*ahem* I mean... I think I need some exercise, right? And so... cardio might be a good place to start?$6#$b#Right?$l
event-75160405.25: *giggle* Silly!$l#$b#But... yeah, I think I need a day off too.$l#$b#And being a doctor, I have to promote physical wellness! So cardio sounds good.$l
event-75160405.26: Nice!$h#$b#So then... um... I guess it's a date, then?$l
event-75160406.01: You know...$l#$b#You've been staring at me an awful lot more than usual.$l#$b#Is there something on my face?$8#$b#Don't tell me all this time we've been walking I had something in my face!$u
event-75160406.04: Hey! Come on! I was just messing with you!$h#$b#Don't worry, you're fine.
event-75160406.06: Huh? Hey! What did you say?#$b#Come on! Ton! I didn't hear it!$6
event-75160406.09: *Giggle* This feels really nostalgic, doesn't it?$8#$b#Wasn't this cliff the place where we first met each other when we were kids?$h

event-75160406.14: Nah, you were amazing.$h#$b#...You still are.$l

event-75160406.25: Thank you... For being in my life.$l
Offering.Prismatic: This is an intriguing and colorful offering! I'm grateful, oh farmer.#$b#I'll bestow upon you a blessing!$h
event-75160407.01: What's the matter, my love? You've been lost in thought all day.$s
event-75160407.02: Yes, there has been something on my mind now for quite some time...$s
event-75160407.03: Not long ago I noticed that on the last day of each season, the valley's magical aura suddenly spikes in intensity.$s#$b#I have tried and tried to find the source, but to no avail. It disappears just as quickly as it came.$s
event-75160407.04: Ah, yes, that has been happening for as long as I can remember.$h#$b#You shouldn't let it trouble you, my love. In all my years, nothing negative has ever come from it.
event-75160407.05: Even so, that much magic is never a good sign.$s#$b#It would be a waste not to search for it today, while its cause may still linger - even if just so we are finally able to put this question to rest.$a
event-75160407.06: Well, my dear, you know I'm never one to turn down a bit of adventure.$h
event-75160407.07: For quite some time there has been a potent source of magic seeping into this soil.#$b#Could this be the source of it?
event-75160407.08: No... This feels like a completely different type of magic. The magic we're seaching for feels much more... natural than this.$s
event-75160407.09: ...This happens every time! I track down the source and it just leads to another dead end... It's infuriating.$s
event-75160407.10: Oh, Bel, I hate to see you looking so glum.$s#$b#But I have faith that we can find it together.$l
event-75160407.11: ...You're right. I will not allow myself to quit this easily. Let's continue.$l
event-75160407.12: Rae, do you feel that?#$b#It may be faint, but the aura feels similar to that of the magic spikes.$h#$b#It seems to be originating from...
event-75160407.14: No, that can't be right. The only thing that lives here is that tortoise.$s
event-75160407.15: Actually, that may indeed be the answer...$h
event-75160407.16: Now that I reflect on the matter, that tortoise has always been a strange phenomenon...$s#$b#There was one living in the valley when I first came into being, and there has never not been one since - but always just the one...$s#$b#...It's so simple! How could I have not seen this before?$u
event-75160407.17: That cannot be! That would make him hundreds-- no, thousands of years old!!$u
event-75160407.19: The source of the magic seems to be emanating from inside here.$a#$b#The truth is within my grasp now... I will not let it elude me again.$7
event-75160407.20: I'll come with you. We don't know what might be waiting on the other side...$a
event-75160407.21: My eyes must be deceiving me... Something this astonishing has been hidden from our sight for this long?$u
event-75160407.22: Ah, I knew the day would eventually come that you two would find me here.
event-75160407.23: So this is what you truly look like, tortoise. I never would have suspected...$u#$b#But, why hide a form as stunning as this? Surely you have nothing to fear, given your immense power?$s
event-75160407.24: Let me start from the beginning. My tale will answer that question and many more, dear spirit.#As you have likely surmised, I am not a spirit like you, but a Lesser Deity - a guardian of this planet.#When this realm was created, my kin and I were birthed along with it. Our task is to protect it - to ensure that the balance of nature is never overturned.#In the past, I was much more lenient when it came to my true form. I never saw any reason to disguise myself from the humans.#I had even come to trust a group of them, for a time.#But in the face of power, human hearts are quickly seized by greed. They sought to use my powers for their petty wars and indulgent campaigns.#Once, I decided to aid a village that I had grown quite fond of in their military efforts... It was a long, arduous war in which I used my own powers to harm the very creatures I was meant to protect.#Not long after that, I decided to keep myself hidden from them - for both my sake and theirs.#And so I adopted the humble guise that you have come to know, dear spirits.
event-75160407.25: But how can you fulfill your duty of protection in such a diminished form?$s#$b#Surely there are ways to help humanity without completely recusing yourself from their affairs...?$s#$b#Those people believed in you, and you yourself said that you cared for them - but you abandoned them...$s
event-75160407.26: Your words have some truth to them, though it pains me to admit it. But I do not regret my actions.#I have never had any desire for humanity's love or worship. The task my kin and I were presented with is a lonely one, but nonetheless one I do not take lightly.#As a nature spirit yourself, you know as well as I that the balance of nature is easily swayed. Any semblance of favoritism on my part could swiftly prove disastrous for both humanity and the planet's development.#We watch over humans, animals, monsters, and even spirits such as you two. Were I to give my assistance only to a select few, they would thrive, yes - but the other creatures would indubitably pay the price.#What right have I, a supposed guardian, to sentence so many to such a fate?
event-75160407.27: That being said, I do not recall ever saying that I stopped assisting the humans entirely... *wink*
event-75160407.28: Well, then... With this, I have given you two something to think about with regard to your own places in the universe.#Farewell, dear spirits. I'll be following your journeys with only the highest of expectations.

Festivals.EggFest.Zayne: I hope you enjoy the festivities today and keep your egg-citement on a high level!$h#$b#Oh dear, I apologize. That was a terrible pun!$u
Festivals.EoR.Zayne: What are your resolutions for the upcoming year, @?#$b#I do hope you'll have an even more eventful one than the last.
Festivals.FlowerDance.Zayne: This festival is a great showcase of grace and cavalry.#$b#Grandmother's always taught us to uphold honor in all our ways, and this was the first festival she let us take our first go at it.
Festivals.Gathering.Zayne: I sometimes get aggressive during competitions.#$b#I guess it stems from growing up in a competitive family. As young as Nadaline and Louie are, we were taught to strive to be better than everybody else and uphold our family's honor.
Festivals.IceFest.Zayne: I never had the time to learn how to fish before.#$b#Sonny and the other maids would take care of catching the fish since we were young.#$b#Well, either that or Grandmother has crates of fish being flown in from somewhere abroad.
Festivals.Luau.Zayne: The Governor and Grandmother are close friends.#$b#His presence today gives us the opportunity to be caught up with politics on a more direct level.
Festivals.Jellies.Zayne: The jellies present a source of energy that one might be able to use in electricity.#$b#Hmm, maybe I could request some of our scientists to take a look into that.$6
Festivals.SpiritEve.Zayne: Spirit Eve used to be my favorite festival.#$b#I guess I've outgrown it. Or maybe, adult responsibilities hinder me from enjoying this day.#$b#Hmm...$s
Festivals.StardewFair.Zayne: I trust you put your best foot forward for this festive day, @?
Festivals.WinterStar.Zayne: I hope your secret person got what you wanted, or what you needed, @.#$b#I wish you the best in the next days to come.
Zayne.Dialogue.Mon8: This village and the land around it has so much potential of commercial use.#$b#But, I'm sure the locals wouldn't appreciate that.$h#$b#And so, I'll cease these unnecessary ideas.$7
Zayne.Dialogue.Tue8: Ah, it's a pleasure seeing you @.#$b#What brings you here this fine day?$h#$e#I'm expecting an important call from a business partner soon. So if you'll excuse me.
Zayne.Dialogue.Wed8: Preparing to take over Grandmother's position is a daunting task.$s#$b#But that's to be expected. Her position is no laughing matter.
Zayne.Dialogue.Thu8: Are the produce in %farm shipped per day as soon as they're available or per month?#$b#I bet you try to prepare and organize as much as you can in your business.#$b#Because what else would result to such a successful farm like yours?$h
Zayne.Dialogue.Fri8: I don't have many friends in this village, given that I travel a lot.$7#$b#And so, I would like to express my gratitude in having you as a friend, @.$h#$b#If you ever need anything, I'll be here to try to be of assistance.
Zayne.Dialogue.Sat8: The Amethyne Corporation oversees the many businesses of the family.#$b#But it doesn't limit to family-owned businesses. We also like to invest in start-up companies that show potential.$h
Zayne.Dialogue.Sun8: The village festivals here are fun, are they not?#$b#If ever I was given the opportunity, I'd like to attend one! I'm sure it would be a wonderful experience!$h#$e#Please do tell me if there's an upcoming one, @. I'd like to have you as company when I do attend.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.spring_1: Spring is a good time to refresh marketing opportunities.#$b#And maybe even refresh our spark?$6#$b#What do you say to us, maybe taking a trip or planning a little picnic at the Log Cabin Hotel, love?
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.spring_12: Are you ready for the festival tomorrow?#$b#Louie has been reminding me non-stop that we have to support him during the egg hunt.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.spring_23: I'm going to practice my dancing skills for you my love. I'll make sure to sweep you off your feet tomorrow.$6
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.summer_1: Ah, the first day of summer!#$b#We must beat the summer heat by taking a plunge in the pool at the mansion, love!$h#$b#Or maybe we could build one right at home.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.summer_10: Love, please make sure that you'll bring the top quality ingredients okay?#$b#Grandmother will be horrified if she finds out that we ever tried to bring something below standard.$u
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.summer_27: Why don't we bring a picnic blanket for tomorrow?$6#$b#That way we'll get to have our own moment after the jellies have passed.$4
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.fall_1: Brr, cold season's already starting my love.#$b#Make sure to dress warm, okay?#$e#If you need anything we could have Faye or our tailors make one for you.
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.fall_15: Good luck for tomorrow, my love!$h#$b#I'm sure your showcase will earn a prize tomorrow!$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.fall_19: The competition for this year's gathering is quite intense.$u#$b#I told the other men that we have got to step up our game if we want to win this thing tomorrow!$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.fall_26: Are you planning on dressing up tomorrow my love?#$b#I'm a bit excited to see you in a costume.$4
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.winter_1: Hot cocoa, and dates in front of the fireplace every night when we go home please.$4
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.winter_7: Your fishing skills will be put to the test tomorrow. Are you ready to take the challenge, love?$6
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.winter_24: Thinking about it right now, I don't care about what gift I receive tomorrow because I've got you here by my side already and that is the best gift anyone could ever ask for.$4
I know traveling is considered a privilege for most people.#$b#I, for one, enjoyed my days of traveling and I am very grateful that my family has the capability to go to and from places at a moment's notice.#$b#But now, I'm glad to be able to settle in one place. Especially because that place has you in it.$l
My love, do you have any interests in taking a role in the Amethyne Corp.?#$b#I could make arrangements for you if you'd like.
I'm glad that I could make a greater impact on the world because of my position...$l#$b#I really appreciate you for pushing me to my greater potential, love. You really are my lucky charm!$h

I'm worried about the pressure that Grandmother is putting on the little children.$s#$b#Nadaline and Louie should get to enjoy their childhood without fear of failing...$7#$e#I hope I create a safer environment for them, as well as our children to grow up in.$s

Love, what are your opinions about drinking tea during meetings?#$b#In my opinion I actually find them quite appalling.$u#$b#But I sometimes fake liking it because other cultures consider it as a sign of respect and enjoyment.
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.patio_Zayne.1: Tsk, it's such a busy day of business calls and organization meetings.$s#$b#I'm glad you're here to cheer me on though.$l
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.patio_Zayne.2: Ah, the atmosphere in the city could not compare to what we have here on the farm, love.#$b#I'd always choose this above all else.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.patio_Zayne.3: I hear that the governor is thinking of running for a higher position at the upcoming elections.#$b#Grandmother seems to think that it isn't a good idea though.#$b#I just hope her mind doesn't wander to asking me to run for a position.$u
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.patio_Zayne.4: It's nice that I have the chance to spend more time with you now that I'm no longer an ambassador.$h#$b#I guess that's one of the great perks of being an Amethyne.
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.patio_Zayne.5: Do you ever think about the future, love?#$b#Like about the things that you still want to achieve.#$e#I know we're at this point in our lives that we're already supposed to acquire all the things we want.#$b#But what happens next?$s
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_0: I used to like rain when I was younger.#$b#Lorraine and I used to play outside whenever the rain came.#$b#Then we'd run away from Sonny because Grandmother would scold us every time.$h#$b#Those were the days.$s
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_1: Do you ever notice how the ground would smell every time it rains?#$e#Oddly so, some people like the smell enough to make it a fragrance.$u#$b#Which is why the Amethyne Corp. has a dew scent fragrance that is being sold in some places.
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_2: Rainy days are useful in the farming industry, right love?#$b#Just as long as it's not too much rain though.$s#$e#Hmm, maybe we could ask the Amethyne experts to make a plan for cases like that. So that we could make sure that nothing bad will happen to our farm.$7
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_3: Love, make sure to either bring an umbrella or use a cap to protect yourself from the rain please.$s
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_4: *Sigh* Love, it's raining and I know I can't stop you from going outside so please, be responsible enough to take care of yourself. Okay?$7
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_Zayne: The rain gives me a certain calmness that I don't understand.#$b#The pitter-patter of raindrops gives me a chance to think about things on a different level.$l
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_0: It's comforting that I get to hug you in this rainy evening.$l#$b#Aren't you so lucky?$6
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_1: The pitter-patter of rain reminds me of tap dancers that Grandmother and I used to watch at the theatre.#$b#You should have seen them, they look so incredible.$h#$b#We should try and catch a show in one of our next trips.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_2: It's quite alright that the stars are hiding tonight.#$b#It is because the most dazzling star is shining in your eyes.$4
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_3: The goal of the AMC is to somehow capture the beauty of stars in the sky and place them on jewelry.#$b#Isn't it just brilliant?$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_4: Hmm... Love? What do you think about foldable tents?#$b#My mind's just been running around about how foldable tents would be useful especially for those who are in difficult positions.#$b#I think our charity organizations could make use of it for sure.
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_5: Love, you're getting wet.$u#$b#*Sigh*$s#$b#Well it's a good thing that I bought you some pumpkin soup [236].#$b#Here you go!$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_Zayne: Oh, the rain is just pouring.$s#$b#I wanted to take you out on a hot air balloon tonight.$s#$e#Oh well, we could just stay in and cuddle. That would be exciting!$h#$b#I'll just reschedule the hot air balloon then.
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_0: One of the great perks about being your own boss, is that I get to see you at any time of the day as I wish.$h#$b#As long as I get my to-do list done within the day of course.$6
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_1: Ah, my beautiful partner!#$b#Here's a little something that I got flown in from Emerald City! [279]#$b#I hope you like it!$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_2: My, I've got a busy day ahead of me love.$s#$b#I wish I could take you with me.$7
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_3: Why, my love! You look as radiant as ever!$4#$b#You make me feel butterflies and confetti in my stomach.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_4: Ah, seeing you in good spirits is enough to get me going through the day, love.$h#$b#I just know my day will be productive.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_Zayne: I really love seeing your face in the morning.$4#$b#It's the highlight of my everyday.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_0: I often feel drained at night, for my days are always heavy on account of my responsibilities to the family.$7#$b#But I am glad that it is you that I get to spend my nights with because you make me feel safe and at peace.$4
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_1: Night time has always allowed me to think about what happened during the day.#$b#I guess today's alright for me, what about yours, love?
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_2: Are there things that you wish that you could have done sooner, love?$7#$b#I don't know, there are times that my head just says 'you could have done so much more today.'$s
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_3: %Zayne seems to be out of it.#$b#Oh, there you are my love.$h#$b#I was just thinking about the day's work and I'm mentally checking my checklist to ensure that I didn't forget anything.
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_4: How was your day, my love?#$b#Were you able to do something productive?$6
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_Zayn: Love? May I get a hug from you?$7#$b#Oh it's nothing, I just feel a bit down right now.$s#$b#Father was disappointed because the trucks that were supposed to pick up the gems at the AMC got held up at the border.$7#$b#And because of that, Grandmother got mad.$s#$b#Then everything else was just... *sigh*#$b#I'm just happy to get to hug you now, my love.$7
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_0: Oh, there you are, love!#$b#I just wanted to check up on you and give you this! [337]#$b#Sonny just had them delivered earlier because Father insisted on having us use it because they found some in the mines.
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_1: There have been reports about the Governor's opponents walking around town looking for trouble.$7#$b#Grandmother says we should be wary and disengage whenever something arises.#$b#Please, keep safe my love.$s#$e#Maybe I should hire a bodyguard for you.$7
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_2: Isn't it a wonderful day out, love?$6#$b#I'm glad that I get to see you in the middle of it.$h#$b#Now I must be off, there's lots more to do. I'll see you later, love.
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_3: The outdoors are always the perfect setting to meet my darling partner.$h#$b#Besides the bedroom, that is.$6#$e#Oh come on, I was just teasing, love.$6
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_4: I've always been fond of the outdoors.#$b#I mean, you'd expect it from me because I always travel a lot. However the reason isn't exactly that.#$b#But instead, it is because of the feeling that I get whenever I see an open space. I see endless possibilities.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Zayne.1: Farewell, my love!$h#$b#The thirst to prove myself is quelling at the edge of my being! I am excited to make a change in our little world.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Zayne.2: So long, my love!#$b#Have a productive day today!$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Zayne.3: Now I must bid you adieu, love. Grandmother's waiting for me.#$b#And I must contact the jet's pilot because she and I might be traveling to a nearby island to sign a contract today.
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Zayne.4: Good bye, love. I'll see you later.#$b#I'm late for a meeting.$u
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Zayne.5: I'll miss you, my @.$7#$b#But I'm afraid I have to leave now.$s#$e#Don't forget your things, okay?#$b#Make sure you've got everything you need, alright?
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Zayne.1: Oh I just love coming home to you, love.$4#$b#You make evenings feel like a breeze.$4
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Zayne.2: The day's been quite hectic.$7#$b#But man, am I glad that I'm here with you now.$s#$e#Can you give me a hug, love?$s#$b#Ah, now I feel rejuvenated. Thanks love, I appreciate it.$4
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Zayne.3: The greatest thing about every day since we got married is that I get to go home to you!$h#$b#Man, am I delighted to see you, my love!$4
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Zayne.4: There are two good things that I look forward to at the end of the day.#$b#First, it's that time I get to reflect on the things that I was able to do during the day.#$b#And second, is that I get to see you when I come home.$6
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Zayne.5: Hello, my love.$h#$b#How did your day go by?#$b#Did you miss me?$6
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_0: My, isn't %kid1 amazing.$h#$b#The little tyke's quite intelligent for a kid.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_1: *Sigh* %kid1 is growing up too fast.$s#$b#Is it bad that I want the child to stay that way?$7#$b#I just want to shield %kid1 from the horrors of the real world.$7
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_2: Louie has been yapping about teaching %kid1 to be as sophisticated as he is.$h#$b#It's quite adorable to see how excited he is to be an uncle.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_3: There's nothing more that I'd want in life, love.$4#$b#You and %kid1 mean the most to me in the world.$4
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_0: Love, Grandmother's been asking about what languages we plan on teaching the kids.#$b#Regardless of what Grandmother thinks we just have to make sure that they won't feel pressured and force themselves to do something they don't want.$7
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_1: Thank you for the sacrifices that you made for our family, love.#$b#I know I may not speak of it as often as I should. But I want to let you know that I really appreciate all the things you do for me and the kids.$4#$b#I love you, @.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_2: I know that I said I was happy before. But now I know that this, us four, is what true happiness looks like.$4#$b#Thank you for giving me the chance to be a part of this family.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_3: Nadaline and Louie have been arguing about who the best aunt or uncle is.$h#$b#It's quite charming how they'd fight about who'd be the best babysitter for %kid1 and %kid2.$h#$b#As if we'd let them both babysit our little angels.$u
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Good_0: Oh, it's a good thing that I found you, love.$h#$b#I've been yearning your hugs since we left this morning.$4
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Good_1: Isn't it just lovely that we get to spend all this time together.$h#$e#I mean, being the head of the Amethynes is a big responsibility, however its perks are even better.#$b#It meant that I got to stay here with you!$4#$b#While also make a big change in the lives of the people who are working under me.$6
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Good_2: Have I ever told you that you look as beautiful as pearls in the bottom of the high seas.$4#$b#I'm glad that I have you as my life partner, love.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Good_3: There hasn't been a day since we were married that I second guessed my decision.#$b#You are the thing that I am most sure of, my @.$4#$e#Well, you and my family obligations of course.$6
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Good_4: Love!$h#$b#Stocks at Amethyne Corp. have been skyrocketing!$h#$b#Maybe you really are my good luck charm, huh?$6
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Good_5: The thing about choosing an excellent partner in life is knowing how compatible you both are with each other.#$b#Furthermore, it is also about knowing how to treat each other kindly as well as adjusting to each other's mood.#$b#I'm grateful that you really understand the best way to deal with me, and I you.$4#$e#We must be meant for each other.$h#$b#As cheesy as it may sound.$6
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Good_6: Grandmother has been singing your praises, love!$h#$b#She's quite impressed at how you turned your grandfather's farm around and she feels that he would have been proud by how you're taking care of it right now.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Good_7: Ariah and I were talking the other day and she mentioned how she thinks of you as a role model.$6#$b#I'm well pleased with that.$h#$b#Thank you for setting a good example to the young ones in our family, love.$4
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Good_8: Love, I know that I seldom share my feelings with you as well as taking the time to express how much you mean to me.#$b#And I'd just like to say that I admire how understanding you have been with me since the very beginning.$4#$b#I cherish you, love. No words could ever suffice the gravity of my feelings for you.$4
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Good_9: Being with you has been the ride of a lifetime, and I don't ever want to get off it.$h#$b#I love you, my @.$4
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_0: I'm a bit worried about the future, love...$s#$b#What if what I've done and what I'm doing is not enough.$7
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_1: There are certainly days in which I believe I am invincible at times.$6#$b#But ailments like this remind me that I am not.$7
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_2: Father has been talking about expanding the restaurant here in the valley.#$b#However, I believe it isn't wise since the competition here is tight.#$e#I suppose a pop-up food cart would be better, don't you think so, love?
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_3: The company recently bought a private jet to transport the amethysts from the AMC to the goldsmiths so that it'll be easier for them.#$e#I visited the company goldsmiths last time and phew their job is tough.$u#$b#Setting the stones on the gold hardware, as well as following the designs is a lot of hard work.$u
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_4: It pains me to see how other people are under-compensated for doing their jobs.#$e#I recently reviewed news articles that talked about how workers in the city are protesting because they're underpaid.$7#$b#This. This is why I'm working hard. To ensure that the Amethyne Corp. will be different.#$b#Will be better than others.
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_5: Love, would you like to go on my next work trip with me?#$b#We'll make it our 2nd honeymoon.$h
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_6: $y 'My love, what do you think about heading organizations? Grandmother's looking for a charity buddy. Maybe you'd like to volunteer._Sure, I'd love to._Great! I'll inform Grandmother once she's planning on establishing a new one._No, I'm good._Ah, I understand. I'm sure Grandmother would to.'
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_7: *Sigh* My schedule's so tight these days.$s#$b#Mostly because other people couldn't stick to a schedule.$a
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_8: Hey, love please take note of the things that we need and give my secretary a list when you can.#$b#I don't want us to lose any goods here a home.
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_9: I'm thinking, maybe we should have some premium cows flown in.#$b#I find myself craving steak right now.$7#$b#I guess I'm that stressed, huh.$s
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Bad_0: I do not have the time, nor the energy to argue with you right now. I'm extremely busy!$a#$b#Please, leave me be.$7
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Bad_1: I apologize, I do not have the time for this right now.$7
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Bad_2: I do not think it is wise to aggravate me, right now.$7#$b#Auntie has been calling me non-stop, kindly find someone else to bother.$a
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Bad_4: I do not care for the pleasantries as of the moment. Please excuse me.$s
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Bad_5: I'm quite tired right now.$7#$b#Let's talk later.$s
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Bad_6: There isn't enough time to discuss whatever it is that you wish.$a#$b#Excuse me.$7
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Bad_7: Whatever you wish to discuss, it isn't worth my time anymore.$a
Zayne.MarriageDialogue.Bad_8: I do not wish to speak to you right now.$s
Festivals.EggFest.Zayne_spouse: I remember attending my first Egg Festival when I was young.$h#$b#I had quite the competitive side back then.$h
Festivals.FlowerDance.Zayne_spouse: Remember to save me your first and last dance later, my love.$6#$b#I practiced my waltz for you earlier.$h
Festivals.Luau.Zayne_spouse: I do hope nobody gets food poisoning from this.$u#$b#To be honest, that has always been a fear of mine because in one of my travels, I once saw a fellow ambassador sent to the hospital because of food poisoning.$s#$b#Nevertheless, I've asked some personnel to keep watch of the ingredients being put in just to be on the safer side.$7
Festivals.Jellies.Zayne_spouse: Come near me when the festival is about to start, alright love?#$b#I want to us to see the jellies together.$6#$b#Oh, of course if that's alright with you too.$4
Festivals.StardewFair.Zayne_spouse: Grandmother is eyeing potential employees.#$b#She says the fair could bring out someone's wit and perseverance which is why she takes this opportunity to observe other people's behavior.
Festivals.SpiritEve.Zayne_spouse: The spread's quite grand this year.#$b#I wonder if we could get whoever made this cater our company's anniversary party?
Festivals.IceFest.Zayne_spouse: I'm not much of a fisherman really.$s#$b#Maybe next time you could teach me, love?$4
Festivals.WinterStar.Zayne_spouse: I do hope that my secret person will like my gift.$7#$b#I contemplated on adding a private jet trip but, I think it'll be too much.$4
Festivals.Gathering.Zayne_spouse: My competitive side is being awaken by this festival.$h#$b#I hope the men win this one!$h#$e#But regardless of who wins, as long as I get to cuddle with you tonight, I'd already be a winner.$h
Festivals.EoR.Zayne_spouse: I'm absolutely overjoyed by the thought of spending another year with you, love.$4#$b#Here's to more years for us!$h
Zayne.Dialogue.Mon8.dating: Greetings my love, I wish you a wonderful day today!$h
Zayne.Dialogue.Tue8.dating: Hello, love! How have you been feeling?#$b#Why don't we grab coffee together soon.$4#$b#I miss you quite terribly.$4
Zayne.Dialogue.Wed8.dating: Love, is there anything that you'd like?#$b#We could go on a date on my day off. That is, if you'd give me the pleasure.$4
Zayne.Dialogue.Thu8.dating: You can't get enough of me, can you?$6#$b#Haha, I know you miss me.$6#$e#I can't wait till the weekend where we can have our date night.$4
Zayne.Dialogue.Fri8.dating: Work's been very hectic these days.$s#$b#But I'm glad that i can see you in my little windows of rest during the day.$4
Zayne.Dialogue.Sat8.dating: You are my refuge, love.#$b#Thank you, for making me feel content.$4
Zayne.Dialogue.Sun8.dating: Love?$s#$b#I'm afraid that I might make myself scarce in the upcoming week.$7#$b#Grandmother's asking me to go on a business trip.#$e#But I do hope that it won't keep me long.$7#$b#I shall take our family jet so that I can return as soon as possible.
Zayne.Dialogue.Mon10.dating: There's so many random things that are going on in my head.#$b#But one thing's for certain...#$b#You'll always be the one to get my head sorted out because you understand me in a way no one else does, @.$4
Zayne.Dialogue.Tue10.dating: It's quite enchanting to think about how much we've grown together as a couple.$4#$b#I mean, we're only dating but I must admit that I've been learning a lot from you.
Zayne.Dialogue.Wed10.dating: What's that my love? You miss me?$6#$b#Haha, it's alright I miss you too.$h#$b#You must come with me on one of my work trips next time.$h
Zayne.Dialogue.Thu10.dating: Love, here's some blueberries I had flown in. [258]#$b#I hope you like them.$4
Zayne.Dialogue.Fri10.dating: I've never been the type to date around, and am I glad that I waited for someone like you to come into my life.$4#$b#The responsibilities of being an Amethyne is a tad bit lighter because I know you're here to support me.$h#$b#Thank you for being here, @.
Zayne.Dialogue.Sat10.dating: Ah, it's the weekend!$h#$e#I can't wait to spend the day with you!$h#$b#I just hope that nothing will interrupt us this time.$7
Zayne.Dialogue.Sun10.dating: I don't know if I should be glad that it's a Sunday or if I should dread it because it's going to be monday tomorrow.$u#$e#I swear I'm not lazy, it's just that I want to make up for lost time with you.$7
Zayne.Dialogue.Resort_Entering: Oh how quaint.#$b#It can't compare to the private resorts that our family goes to.#$b#But it's got quite the charm, I think I'm going to like it here.$h
Zayne.Dialogue.Resort_Leaving: *Sigh* Back to the real world once again.$s#$b#Oh well, at least I get to help make people's lives better. Especially my family's.
Zayne.Dialogue.Resort_Shore: I always think of the horizon as a symbol for new beginnings and beautiful endings.#$b#It's quite like how the sun would rise and set in the horizon. It's just so exquisite. Don't you think so too, @?
Zayne.Dialogue.Resort_Bar: What are you having, @?#$b#I wanted to have something with a little kick, however I have business reports to do at home.$7
Zayne.Dialogue.Resort: I almost didn't want to come here today, as I have much to do at home.#$b#But I'm glad that I did as I needed the rest.$4
Zayne.Dialogue.MovieInvitation: Why, thank you for the invite, @.$h#$b#I'll meet you at the theatre then. Just let me leave some contracts at home.
Zayne.Dialogue.breakUp: I'm sorry, I do not wish to have anything to do with you.$a
Zayne.Dialogue.danceRejection: My apologies, I must decline your offer.$7#$b#Maybe you could ask someone else?
Zayne.Dialogue.divorced: I mourn for the way we used to be, @.$s#$b#It's such a shame, we could have been the perfect couple.$7
Romance.Engagement.Zayne0: You don't say? Oh but of course, I'll marry you!$h
Romance.Engagement.Zayne1: Are you quite certain that you'd want to spend the rest of your life with me?$6#$b#Well then, I accept your proposal! I love you!$4
Romance.give.flowersA.Zayne: I'll do my best to be worthy of your affections, @.$4#$b#I accept your token.$h
Romance.give.flowersB.Zayne: This is quite charming of you.$4#$b#Can't wait to keep me all to yourself, huh?$6#$b#Haha! I adore you.
Romance.stardrop.gift.Zayne: Love, here's a little token of my appreciation for you.$h#$b#I hope you put it to good use, okay?$h
Romance.rejectNPCA.Zayne: I must apologize, but I don't think I could accept this.$7#$b#I barely even know you.$u
Romance.rejectNPCB.Zayne: My sincerest apologies, @.$s#$b#I must have given you the wrong impression but I don't think that we're in that level yet.$7
Romance.MovieInvite.Spouse.Zayne: Aww, you miss me don't you?$6#$b#I'm glad you invited me! I'm also craving for an alone time with you.$4#$b#I'll see you in a bit, love.$h

MovieData.Zayne.SpringMovie0.Like.AfterM: That was quite wholesome. I appreciate you inviting me!$h

MovieData.Zayne.SummerMovie0.Like.AfterM: I'm now assured to tell Louie that this movie's quality is top-notch!$h
MovieData.Zayne.FallMovie0.Love.BeforeMo: Oh my! I've been desiring a good mystery show lately.$h

MovieData.Zayne.WinterMovie0.Like.AfterM: That was quite wholesome. I appreciate you inviting me!$h
