Romance.FemaleWeddingFix.MaleFarmer1.Ire: When @ first arrived in Pelican Town, no one knew if he'd fit in with our community...#$b#But from this day forward, @ is going to be as much a part of this town as any of us!$h#$b#It is my great honor on this day {0} of {1}, to unite @ and Irene in the bonds of marriage.
Romance.FemaleWeddingFix.MaleFarmer2.Ire: @... Irene... #$b# As the mayor of Pelican Town, and regional bearer of the matrimonial seal, I now pronounce you husband and wife!$h
Romance.FemaleWeddingFix.FemaleFarmer1.I: When @ first arrived in Pelican Town, no one knew if she'd fit in with our community...#$b#But from this day forward, @ is going to be as much a part of this town as any of us!$h#$b#It is my great honor on this day {0} of {1}, to unite @ and Irene in the bonds of marriage.
Romance.FemaleWeddingFix.FemaleFarmer2.I: @... Irene... #$b# As the mayor of Pelican Town, and regional bearer of the matrimonial seal, I now pronounce you wife and..., well, wife!$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.spring_1: Langga, could you grow some pretty little flowers for me?$4#$b#I'd like to experiment on using decorative flowers on my dishes.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.spring_12: I overheard Pika talk to Gus the other day, and they said that they were trying to perfect a certain egg pie recipe for tomorrow.#$b#Maybe this is my chance to impress them both!$h#$b#I've got to bake a sample for them right now!$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.spring_23: I've been talking to Faye about my dress for tomorrow.#$b#I wanted her to make me something flowy and dreamy.$8#$e#Oh I hope she finishes on time.$u
Irene.MarriageDialogue.summer_1: Langga, do you like cold delicacies?#$b#The Madame used to ask for summer menus for the Purple Mansion.#$b#I remember squeezing my brain out for unique cold dishes!$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.summer_10: Make sure to put something savory in tomorrow's dish, okay langga?#$b#You could never go wrong with something savory.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.summer_27: I'm looking forward to tomorrow night!$h#$b#The starry night would be so romantic!$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.fall_1: Fall is here!$h#$b#I don't know why but it makes me feel excited haha.$h#$b#I love cooking treats for fall!$h#$e#But strangely so, a lot of my friends don't like pumpkin-y flavors, so when I cook for them, I sometimes substitute dishes with avocado or sweet potato to compensate for the flavors.
Irene.MarriageDialogue.fall_15: Are you excited for tomorrow, langga?#$b#I'm really looking forward to tomorrow's festivities because Pika and Gus will be showcasing their best recipes!$8#$e#I'm really looking forward to the day I could showcase alongside them.$4
Irene.MarriageDialogue.fall_19: I'll be assisting Pika and Gus with the food preparation for tomorrow's gathering.#$b#*Squeee*! It's going to be so much fun!$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.fall_26: Faye has been looking forward to tomorrow for ages!$h#$b#She's been bugging me to do a matching costume with her, but I said that it'd be cuter if we're the ones who match.$8#$b#It's because you fit me well like an oven mitt, @.$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.winter_1: Winter's here!$h#$b#Season for marshmallows, hot cocoas, and cuddles$h#$b#I'm looking forward to doing and eating all those with you, my langga!$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.winter_7: Would you like me to bring home some smoked trout and salmon delicacies, langga?#$b#The Madame asked me to cook some for the festival tomorrow.#$b#It seems like she has a hankering for seafood.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.winter_24: I've read somewhere that when you celebrate the Festival of the Winter Star with the person you love, you'll be together forever?$4#$b#I do hope that's true for us, langga.$8
I'm thinking of ways on how to incorporate sweets into meaty dishes.$6#$b#I just find it interesting and complimentary.#$b#Don't you think so, langga?$h
It's crazy to think that we're now married, huh?$8#$b#We used to just say good bye to each other whenever the day is done, but now...$8#$b#I get to come home to you!$h
Maybe we could plan our vacation soon.#$b#Or maybe a stay-cation over at the Log Cabin Hotel?
Hmm, how could I brighten up the room.#$b#What do you think, langga? Should I add something else?
I'm really glad that I found a home in you, @...$4#$b#I know it's a bit random but, looking around our house. And seeing you here, it's just perfect.$8#$b#I feel content...$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.patio_Irene.1: Are you hungry, langga?#$b#I could make some pizza for you if you'd like.$h#$e#Here you go! [206]
Irene.MarriageDialogue.patio_Irene.2: If you'd like soon, my langga, we could make a business out of brick-oven baked garlic bread.#$b#I think it'll be a hit here on the valley.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.patio_Irene.3: We should hold a cookout here soon.$h#$b#Share our blessings with our neighbors. It'll also give me a chance to practice my grilling skills.
Irene.MarriageDialogue.patio_Irene.4: Yikes, there are quite a few mosquitos here.$6#$b#Langga, please remind me to purchase some incense on my next travel.
Irene.MarriageDialogue.patio_Irene.5: It's nice living on the farm, right? I mean yeah, we're far from the city but at least it's peaceful here.#$b#But most importantly, it's the best because you're here.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_0: Good morning, langga! I cooked you some breakfast![204 241 201 733 904 907]$h#$e#Oh dear.$u#$b#It's raining outside, langga. Please bring an umbrella or a raincoat, okay?
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_1: Good morning, langga! I cooked you some breakfast![204 241 201 733 904 907]$h#$e#Before, I had to make warm lemon-chamomile tea for the Madame.#$b#That's her go-to warm drink when it's raining.$h#$e#Did you know that's the first thing that I made for her? When I was being interviewed by the Madame, she had a cold.#$b#I was tasked to make something that would give a good first impression.#$b#And when I gave her my lemon-chamomile tea, she smiled!$h#$b#The Madame doesn't smile that often, but she did! And on our first meeting!$4#$b#I feel so honored, and pressured at the same time.$u#$b#Which is why I always put my best foot forward whenever I work. I don't want to disappoint the Madame.$u
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_2: Good morning, langga! I cooked you some breakfast![204 241 201 733 904 907]$h#$e#The rain is such a romantic thing. Isn't it, langga?$h#$b#I always wanted to dance under the rain.$4#$b#Would you want to dance with me, langga?$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_3: Good morning, langga! I cooked you some breakfast![204 241 201 733 904 907]$h#$e#Oh, Miss Lola told me that she and Sir Freddie used to do the boogie in the rain.#$b#I wonder what she meant by that?$u
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_4: Good morning, langga! I cooked you some breakfast![204 241 201 733 904 907]$h#$e#You know something, langga?#$b#The rain is said to be a blessing for us in my culture.#$b#It is also said that dwarves get married if it's raining and the sun is out.#$b#Hmm, who do you think are those dwarves that they're talking about?$6
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_Irene: Good morning, langga! I cooked you some breakfast![204 241 201 733 904 907]$h#$e#One thing I like about the rain is that it waters the plants which give us plenty of shade to stay under.$4.#$b#When it's sunny again, could we go on a picnic down by the beach?#$b#I want to soak in some sun and have a date with you.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_0: Langga, why don't we dance under the rain?$h#$b#Wouldn't that be so romantic? *Sigh*$4
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_1: The sky looks beautiful even in the rain, doesn't it?#$b#Feeling the water spray on your face, feels so refreshing.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_2: Something just feels right whenever it's raining.#$b#I don't know what it is but I feel calm whenever it does.#$b#It's that magical feeling, you know?$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_3: I really love hearing the pitter patter of rain.#$b#Soon enough it'll be the pitter patter of little feet, won't it?$8#$e#Haha, just kidding langga!#$b#We'll have our own little family whenever we're ready.#$b#Right now I'm happy with just us two.$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_4: The rain gives me the tingles every time.$h#$b#I don't know why, but I just find the rain magical.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_5: Langga...$4#$b#Can we get a blanket and snuggle in front of the fire with some books and smores?$8#$b#That's something that I've been wanting to do since forever!$4
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_Irene: If you let me pick one thing that I like about the rainy season...#$b#It's that there will always be a possibility of us kissing under the rain. And that is SO ROMANTIC.$4#$b#Whoops, I got carried away for a second. Sorry for bursting your eardrums, langga.$s
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_0: Good morning, langga! I cooked you some breakfast![204 241 201 733 904 907]$h#$e#Theeeee morning's here!!!$h#$b#The morning is here!$h#$b#Sunshine is clear, the morning's here!$h#$b#%Irene sings to herself#$e#Oh I'm sorry, langga!$8#$b#I was just singing something I heard from the television.#$b#Puts you in a good mood, doesn't it?$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_1: Good morning, langga! I cooked you some breakfast![204 241 201 733 904 907]$h#$e#I'm thinking of expanding my culinary repertoire, langga.#$b#I'm thinking of making fusion dishes that would compliment each other.#$b#Wouldn't that be innovative?$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_2: Good morning, langga! I cooked you some breakfast![204 241 201 733 904 907]$h#$e#I heard from Sonny yesterday that the Madame got into a rift with Mr. Joja about something in business.#$b#What do you think is the problem?#$b#I'll try to gather more information tomorrow.$7
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_3: Good morning, langga! I cooked you some breakfast![204 241 201 733 904 907]$h#$e#I'm planning to drop by Gus, and Pika's later.#$b#I'd really like to be able to see him, and Pika at work.#$b#I find it so inspiring!$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_4: Jeric and Daia were talking about a bedroom dance.#$b#Do you know what it's about? Can you show me, langga?$4
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_Irene: Good morning, langga! I cooked you some breakfast![204 241 201 733 904 907]$h#$e#Ah! My beautiful ray of sunshine!$h#$b#It's really nice to get to wake up beside you.$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_0: My grandmother used to talk about our hometown folklore when I was younger.#$b#She used to put me to sleep by telling me that there will be a creature with the top half of its body like a horse's and the bottom half of a human called a 'tikbalang' who'll come and get me if I don't sleep early.$7#$e#My Yoba, that gave me the heebie jeebies for years!$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_1: Ahh, that was a tiring day.$s#$b#Could I get a warm hug, langga?$u#$e#%Irene sighs then smiles.#$b#Just what I needed.$4
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_2: Did you know, langga that Corine was gossiping earlier that Ysa burnt water.$h#$b#Haha, that was absolutely funny, langga!$h#$b#Remind me to teach her sometime, okay?
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_3: Ay nako, langga. Sometimes it's a bit stressful hanging around the Amethyne household.$s#$b#Oh! Don't get me wrong! It's just that I feel frustrated for Louie and Ariah sometimes.$s#$b#The pressure that they are under is enough to stress the bejeebers out of you.$a
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_4: Oh my little langga!$h#$b#I missed you!$4#$b#How did your day go?#$e#Want me to make you some pudding? Or flan, if you'd like.$h#$b#That's a good comfort food back at home.
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_Iren: Langga, should we take a trip away soon?#$b#Kind of like a second honeymoon.$4#$e#I miss spending time alone with you, without the pressure of coming back to work for the next day.$u
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_0: I'm really eager to talk to Gus and Pika about my ideas for some dishes.#$b#Do you think they'll go for my ideas?$u
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_1: I've been meaning to go on a hike for some time now.#$b#Being cooped up in the mansion makes my joints hurt which is why it's good to stretch my legs#$e#It's even better right now because I get to see you.$4
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_2: Hello my palangga!$h#$b#Did you miss me so much that you had to see me right now?$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_3: Oh, langga!$h#$b#I was just thinking about you, and you magically appeared!$h#$b#Talk about fate, huh? We really are meant to be!$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_4: It's a wonderful day to be out and about right, langga?#$b#I miss seeing you outside of work and home... Could we schedule a proper date soon? I really do miss you a lot...$s
Irene.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Irene.1: Good bye, langga! I'm off for a walk!$h#$b#I'll see you when I get home!$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Irene.2: I'm feeling pumped to try new recipes today.$h#$b#Wish me luck, langga! I'll see you later!$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Irene.3: So long, pangga! Have a great day ahead!$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Irene.4: I can't wait to see you home later.#$b#Tee hee I know we're just leaving, but I'm already excited to come home to you.$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Irene.5: Have a sweet day ahead, langga!$h#$b#If you want maybe I can send you some treats while you work.$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Irene.1: Home sweet home, my langga!$8#$b#How was your day?
Irene.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Irene.2: Why hello there, langga.#$b#I missed you today.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Irene.3: I did so many things today, it was crazy!$u#$b#But boy am I glad to see you.$4#$b#I missed you so much!$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Irene.4: Oh hello, langga!$h#$b#I'm so glad you're here I had a busy day today and I'm in dire need of your hugs.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Irene.5: %Irene seems to be humming a happy tune.#$b#Oh hello, langga! I've been missing you since this morning!$h#$b#I'm sorry if I get too clingy sometimes. I just like being around you.$4
Irene.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_0: Our little one is just so adorable.$h#$b#%kid1 takes after you, haha. I hope the next one looks like me more.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_1: It's funny how I always pictured you and I having a family together since we first started going out.$4#$b#I never knew that the day would eventually come.#$b#I guess wishes really do come true.$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_2: My, oh my.#$b#%kid1 is so active I sometimes can't keep up.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_3: I'm glad that we have %kid1 in our lives. I can't imagine it being just us two again.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_0: Oh my, Yoba. If I thought that I couldn't keep up with %kid1 before, %kid2 makes it almost impossible.$u#$b#But I love them... and I love you.$8#$b#Thank you for being here with us, langga.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_1: %kid2 really made our little family complete, and I wouldn't have it any other way.$h#$b#I'm glad I have you and our little angels with me.$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_2: I'm astonished at how our kids are growing up so fast!#$b#It's feels just like yesterday that we had them.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_3: Langga...#$e#You and the kids are the greatest blessing that I ever received.#$b#You three are my answered prayer.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Good_0: I'm getting really excited about the new menu I'm constructing!#$b#Can I take you to dinner soon to test it out?$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Good_1: I'm really getting used to living with you, langga.$8#$b#I wouldn't want it any other way.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Good_2: Have you thought about making a house extension, langga?#$b#I think having our own pantry would be so useful, at least I can store herbs and spices in bulk.#$e#I mean what if we have guests coming over or something?#$b#At least we'd be ready.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Good_3: I've been thinking about making some purple sticky rice for dessert.#$b#It's a sweet yuletide treat from home that I quite miss.$s
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Good_4: Faye talked about making me a pretty dress for one of my 'special cooking sessions'. And I think I might just take her up on her offer.$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Good_5: I'm looking forward to more days with you, langga.$h#$b#I'm glad that it's you that I get to spend the rest of my life with.$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Good_6: Did you know that I made a wish on our first date together?#$b#I'm glad that it came true. Hihi.$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Good_7: I've been feeling quite cheerful everyday, lately.$h#$b#I think it has something to do with you, langga.$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Good_8: I've been thinking about expansions lately.#$b#Maybe a restaurant, or a family expansion...$8#$b#What do you think, langga?
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Good_9: At first I thought true love was just some sort of fairytale.#$b#But when I met you, it slowly started to become a reality for me.$8
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_0: I'm really grateful for Madame and the Amethynes.#$b#They pushed me to my fullest potential, I'm really glad to have been a part of their family.
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_1: I'm craving some mangoes...#$b#Hmm, maybe I could have some shipped from the city.#$b#We could make Omu rice and share it with the Kobayashis because I know they'd love some.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_2: Ysa was talking about going out for drinks at the saloon.#$b#I don't know if I should go.#$b#But I think it'll be fun.$4
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_3: I'm glad that you found a home here in the valley.#$b#I wonder what would've happened if you declined your grandfather's farm.$s
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_4: There are times that I wonder if people are thinking about what they want their last meal in the world to be.#$b#I think for me, I'd choose a hearty meal like salted egg with tomatoes and rice, together with barbequed pork, and a tall glass of coconut juice.$4
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_5: The world has so many possibilities, I can't wait till we can explore the world together.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_6: I once read in a book that if two people are meant to be together they almost look identical.#$b#Haha, I've heard some people say we look like siblings. It's so funny!$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_7: I don't know why but I feel quite cold right now...#$b#Maybe I should make grilled cheese and tomato soup.#$b#Would you like some, langga?
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_8: Food has been the one great comfort I have in life.#$b#I'm glad I get to share it with you.$h
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_9: It's crazy how time flies by so fast these days.#$b#I can't believe it's been a few years already.
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Bad_0: Ugh!$7#$b#The creme brulee that I've been baking earlier shattered to pieces as I was heating up the sugar.$7
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Bad_1: Hmph.$6#$e#What?$7#$b#I wanted attention earlier and I don't know... I guess I didn't get it.$u#$b#So just leave me alone right now please.$s
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Bad_2: Why don't you ask me out on dates anymore?$s#$b#I know we're already together but asking for dates would be nice and romantic.$u
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Bad_3: Why would you think that I'd ever like how you're acting towards me the other day.$a#$b#It's like you don't even know me at all!$a
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Bad_4: *Sigh* I'm tired and sweaty from cooking, please don't bother me.$6
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Bad_5: I never thought that someone who I considered to be a hero in my story would actually turn out to be a villain.$s
Irene.MarriageDialogue.Bad_6: I don't have time for you right now, I'm busy.$u

event-75160440.alt.03: Well, welcome!$h#$b#It's a small dinner party, with mostly just family and business partners present.#$b#Grandmother and I had our talk and she wants to officially announce her retirement first to family and friends.#$b#And then, I'll be taking over as the head of the Amethyne family.$7#$b#Which I admit I'm still a bit petrified at the thought of, but ready to do.#$b#I'll face the challenges head on.
event-75160440.alt.09: Ahem!#$b#Requesting everyone's attention.#$b#Madame Maive has an announcement.
event-75160440.alt.13: Success, excellence, pride, grace, and power.#$b#Under the Amethyne name, those are to be expected.#$b#And due to that, pressure comes along with it.#$b#Some may say it's too much, others may say it's harsh.#$b#But without pressure, there are no diamonds.
event-75160440.alt.14: The Amethyne family started in this village, and has remained in it for decades.#$b#Our ancestors strived for excellence and achieved success wherever they could extend their influence.#$b#For many years, I have managed countless businesses and projects under the Amethyne name, aiming to make this world a better place.#$b#My life's goal was to make sure the Amethyne name lives on with our core principles intact throughout the generations.#$b#And I may have done a decent job, but I admit, I feel that I have not done enough to broaden the glow of our purple light around the globe.
event-75160440.alt.15: Which is something that none could say about this young man here with us today.$h
event-75160440.alt.16: My grandson, Zayne Amethyne.#$b#Truly a shining example of the Amethyne potential.$h#$b#Soon, I'll be entrusting the entirety of the Amethyne family's businesses and board seats to this man.#$b#I know my limitations. Only a fool would let pride blind oneself from ruin.#$b#And when I am no longer capable of leading, I will leave the Amethyne name in the best and most trustworthy hands.#$b#Everyone... I hereby announce my retirement to you all. Firstly to my family and friends, then the public.#$b#Welcome the new Amethyne family head, Zayne Amethyne!$h
event-75160440.alt.20: Thank you, Grandmother.#$b#With this title and responsibility, I will make our family proud.$7#$b#And...$7#$b#Give it the necessary happiness and change it deserves.#$b#Our family's core principles have always been aimed to achieve greatness.#$b#And through those principles, I was able to achieve my dreams and so much more.#$b#I was able to help people and contribute to the greater good and well-being of the continent.$7#$b#But to speak truthfully, I believe that it wasn't all just thanks to those principles.#$b#But also with courage, passion, and love.$7#$b#The courage to dream big and never back down even when it scares you.$7#$b#The passion to do what's right and what's needed. Even if the world judges you for it.$7#$b#And love for the country, its people, and my family.$7
event-75160440.alt.21: Family...$7#$b#A big reason why I'm here today is love of family.$7#$b#It's a big undertaking and responsibility, yes.$7#$b#I won't lie if I said I wasn't overwhelmed by the mere thought of the daunting task ahead of me.$s#$b#But people special to me have inspired me to be brave.$7#$b#And I owe everyone here the best I can give, for you all have made me who I am today.$h#$b#I will make you proud. I'll make sure of it!$h#$b#With that, I have a few announcements to make.#$b#First and foremost, the public has yet to learn of this announcement, so please let our family take care of the publicity.#$b#Secondly, I'll be retiring as an ambassador as well, to focus more on overseeing the family and its businesses.#$b#That means I will be staying around Ridgeside Village a lot more.$h#$b#And lastly, thank you everyone for coming.#$b#Enjoy the rest of the party, and once again, thank you. I promise I won't let you down.$h

June.june_arrival.sam: Why did Richard get a pianist to come when our band could play instead?#$b#Just kidding.$7
June.june_arrival.sebastian: Yeah, piano's cool and all, but I just think that the keyboard has a lot more variation.
June.june_arrival.shane: A piano player? What difference does that make to me?$2#$b#Let me know when JojaMart get its own violinist.
June.june_arrival.shiro: Yuuma seems pretty excited about the new pianist. I'm glad.$1
June.june_arrival.sonny: The piano produces such a unique sound. I'll have to encourage the young master to visit the hotel for a performance.
June.june_arrival.trinnie: Mom says she's gonna make me watch piano now... but it sounds boring! I don't wanna go!$2
June.june_arrival.vincent: Miss Penny says we might go on a field trip to see the piano player.#$b#That means no school for a day!$1
June.june_arrival.willy: Me pappy used to play the piano back in the day.#$b#He could rouse up the whole bar with his playin'!$2
June.june_arrival.wizard: The townsfolk are abuzz with news of this pianist.#$b#These humans are quite easily amused.
June.june_arrival.ysabelle: The piano is such a romantic instrument, don't you think?#$e#I'll be getting a free concert while I work!$1
June.june_arrival.yuuma: Did you hear? A real piano player lives here now!$1#$b#...Do you think he'd be willing to teach me, maybe?
June.piano_sign.unmarried: Come see live music played here, Thursdays through Sundays!^Thu + Fri: 5-9PM^Sat: 12-3PM, 5-9PM^Sun: 12-3PM
June.piano_sign.married: Come see live music played here every weekend!^Sat: 12-6PM^Sun: 12-3PM
June.before.sapling: Do you think there will be a musical number? I really hope so.$1
June.before.journey: I love this game! I can't believe they made a movie out of it.$1
June.during.journey: Ugh, the villain looks so creepy...$7
June.after.journey: What a great finale! I love a good action film.$8
June.before.mysterium: This director always has such crazy plot twists. I wonder how it'll turn out this time!$1
June.after.mysterium: Hm... I think I'll have to give this one a re-watch or two to make sure I understand it.#$b#So feel free to invite me again!$1
June.before.coldstar: A tearjerker? I hope I don't cry too much...$2
June.after.coldstar: The score was really beautiful, don't you think?$8
June.before.nature: Documentaries are actually my favorite genre. Who needs fiction when our world is so fascinating on its own?$1
June.during.nature: %June's eyes are glued to the screen.
June.after.nature: Don't you think a raccoon would make a great pet?$1#$b#One used to live under my porch when I was a kid. I would feed it my dinner scraps, but then my mom found out and scolded me.$2
June.before.wumbus: A comedy, huh? I love funny movies!$8
June.after.wumbus: Surely they didn't have to make the alien things so ugly...$3
June.before.howls: So how scary is this movie, exactly?$7#$b#I mean, not that it matters. I'm not scared or anything.$3
June.during.howls: %June is shaking so much you can feel it in your chair.
June.after.howls: ...Um, next time, can we see a nice, happy movie instead?$7
June.before.zuzu: I used to watch this movie with my mom as a kid. I'm so glad they're re-airing it.$1
June.after.zuzu: Do you think she chose to be with him in the end? I know I would if I were her...$4
June.summit.2: Agh, you scared me! When did you get here?$7
June.summit.3: Well, at any rate, I'm glad you came. Any place I'm at is better with you next to me.$2
June.summit.4: Y'know, when I decided to leave Zuzu City, I didn't think anything would change.#$b#It was a last-ditch effort to turn my life around, but I wasn't very optimistic about it.$3#$b#But something was waiting for me that I never could have anticipated...$2#$b#This village, and inside of it, you.$8#$b#Thank you for doing so much to help this town, honey. And know that you mean more to me than you could ever fathom.#5
event-75160411.01.5: After much studying, Kiwi has finally found what Kiwi needs to become unstoppable.
event-75160415.01: I do love being nosy, but can we snoop on younger, hotter people next time?
event-75160415.02: What are we even looking for here, Jio?#$b#We could be out doing something fun.$6
event-75160415.03: Just stay quiet and watch.$2#$b#Something is off about those two... They are no ordinary couple.$2
event-75160415.04: Wait, I know those two!$3#$b#They're bad news, Jio.$2
event-75160415.05: How do you not know? You've been here even longer than I have.#$b#They used to go by the code name of The Hands of Death. Most people know them from the Blood River Incident.$2#$b#We shouldn't get involved with them, Jio. They were known for being downright brutal in combat.$2
event-75160415.06: I've heard of them, but that happened decades ago. You shouldn't worry, they're old now.
event-75160415.07: No, Jio, I mean it! We really should just leave them alone.$2
event-75160415.10: They finally gave up? I'm not sure what they planned to gain from watching us all night.$h#$b#Well, now that that's over, how about we get in some Krav Maga practice, dear?
event-75160412.01: Phew... I think that's everything done for today. And even earlier than I had planned!$h
event-75160412.02: I guess I could use the extra time to walk to the mountains... I haven't really seen that part of the valley yet.$h
event-75160412.03: Wow, the view up here is beautiful! Maybe someday we could bring Onii-san here for a walk!$h
event-75160412.05: There aren't any bears living up here, r-right?$s
event-75160412.07: Alright, I think this is plenty of firewood for the rest of tonight.$h
event-75160412.09: Um... Are you alright, young man?
event-75160412.10: *sniff* Y-yeah... I thought you were something coming to eat me...$4
event-75160412.11: Oh! I didn't mean to scare you. I'm not used to seeing many people around here.$3
event-75160412.12: Here, why don't you take some of these berries I picked earlier?$h
event-75160412.13: Thank you. My name's Yuuma, what's yours?$h
event-75160412.14: Linus. I live in a tent not far from here.
event-75160412.15: A tent? Do you not have a home to live in?$3
event-75160412.16: Well, that tent is my home. Some people may judge me for it, but I prefer to live this way.
event-75160412.17: How do you get your food, then?
event-75160412.18: I get it from the land. If you know the proper way to search for it, the earth provides many forms of food and medicine.
event-75160412.18.5: Would you like me to teach you how to forage?$h
event-75160412.20: Well first off, the most important part is knowing exactly what you can and cannot eat.....
event-75160413.01: ....Anyways, it's always good to see another soldier return.$h
event-75160413.03: It's been hard... Everything is so quiet, yet still so frightening.#$b#Sometimes I wake up at night and don't even recognize where I am...$3
event-75160413.04: How do you do it, Ezekiel? You never seemed bothered by it now.$2
event-75160413.05: Bah, that was a long time ago. Eventually I just noticed that the fear had mostly gone away.
event-75160413.06: Besides, the war was a much different time for me then.
event-75160413.08: After Helen passed, I didn't know what I should do. With the fear of the war coming here as well, the army just felt right for me.$s#$b#It was a hard time, mind you, but it helped to have something to focus on, knowing I was protecting my Corine back at home.$h
event-75160413.09: You have some good kids here as well, Kent, don't forget that.#$b#It may be hard right now but soon enough... Things will almost feel normal again.
event-75160413.10: Thanks, Ezekiel... It's nice to be able to talk to someone who understands.$h
event-75160414.01: Aguar, I have requested before that you do not make these unannounced visits so early in the morning.
event-75160414.02: Yes, yes. You can list all your complaints to me later, but for now there is a more pressing matter for us to attend to.$6#$b#You remember that source of magic that I was tracking before, yes?
event-75160414.03: Of course, but you told me you had found the source and since taken care of it.#$b#Something about a cave under the village if I am correct?
event-75160414.04: Yes... Or well, so I had originally thought.#$b#Earlier this week the same aura made a resurgence, and an extremely strong one at that.#$b#I need your assistance in this matter, Rasmodius. You know as well as I do that a source of magic this strong is never good.
event-75160414.05: Very well. If this magic is as strong as you say, we must act quickly.
event-75160414.06: This magic is unlike anything I have ever seen.#$b#You were right to be worried about this, my friend. Something is certainly dark in the nature of this aura.
event-75160414.07: Yet, I still cannot locate the source!$a#$b#This time the source is too concentrated... Though it seems to be leading deep underground just like before.$5
event-75160414.08: As it is right now, we will have to study these sewers more before we can find the cause of this.
event-75160414.09: Yes, this is something we cannot rush into.#$b#Even with the dangers it poses to the village, we do not know what damage could be wrought by tampering with it.
event-75160414.10: I will return back to my tower and see what I can find in my collection.#$b#I will report to you on my findings.
GuestDialogue.spring1: Zuzu gets so loud during spring break.#I'd rather come out here and listen to the chickens than have one more day of that awful music the kids are listening to!
GuestDialogue.spring2: This is the best season to visit the village!#Don't you think?
GuestDialogue.spring3: Pretty pretty flowers!#I want to see more pretty pretty flowers!#UwU
GuestDialogue.summer1: I hear this beach has wicked waves this type of year.#Goin' to see if I can enter the surfing competition down in Pelican.
GuestDialogue.summer2: I'm going to sign up for that 'pick your own' tour the orchard's doing.#I can't wait to make pies and fruit salads out of them!
GuestDialogue.summer3: Do you think it's safe to ride the cable car during a thunderstorm?#I should check the weather forecast before I check out.
GuestDialogue.summer4: I forgot to bring sun screen!#I guess I just burn and die.
GuestDialogue.fall1: I think this is the best time to visit the village.#You just cannot beat the view from all the way up here.
GuestDialogue.fall2: I've noticed there's a lot of fox decorations around this place... Why's that?
GuestDialogue.fall3: You never know what you're going to find at these little kitschy fall festivals.#It's like a treasure hunt!
GuestDialogue.fall4: A kid just paid me tons just being his butler for the day.#I mean, it's easy cash so I'm not complaining.
GuestDialogue.winter1: Brr!#I forgot it's a lot colder up in the mountains this time of year.#Next time, I'm coming in summer!
GuestDialogue.winter2: I heard there's a bonfire on the side of the mountain to ring in the new year.#Beats my plan of staying in my room and ordering snacks.
GuestDialogue.winter3: I hope that turtle isn't too cold out there, that dog house doesn't seem very insulated.
GuestDialogue.winter4: I wonder if it's cold enough to walk out on the pond.
GuestDialogue.21: I went to Pelican Town the other day, and I have to say I was a bit disappointed.#Zero pelicans.
GuestDialogue.22: This place is much more interesting than Calico.#All there is to do there is walk around the sand!
GuestDialogue.23: Ridgeside surprised me!#It looks nothing like the wiki article.
GuestDialogue.24: The cell reception is so bad out here in the boonies...#How am I supposed to upload my pics to social media now?
GuestDialogue.25: There's nothing like outdoor dining on the side of a mountain!#Well... except when it rains.
GuestDialogue.26: That girl at the outdoor restaurant is so cute!#Do... do you think she's single?
GuestDialogue.27: I'm going to livestream this view to all my Jojacord friends.#They won't believe me otherwise!
GuestDialogue.28: I heard there's ninjas around here! You know, I'm something of a ninja myself. Want to see my jutsus?#Hey, where are you going?
GuestDialogue.29: Don't make that receptionist mad.#Some other guest tried to get mouthy with her, and when she was done, I'd be surprised if there was anything of his ego left intact!
GuestDialogue.30: I discovered there's a chicken farm within walking distance of here!#The hard way. Because we're downwind.
GuestDialogue.31: This place has a lot of raw goods, but you know what it's missing?#That artisanal touch. Lots of opportunity for local jellies and flavored oils!
GuestDialogue.32: That girl working at the restaurant has the cutest glasses!#I asked her about them and she gave me the brand, I'm going to look them up!
GuestDialogue.33: Who decided to build a building up here for water research?#Wouldn't it make more sense to be closer to the ocean?
GuestDialogue.34: I saw the reception girl doing a dance routine at the gym the other day.#Does she teach classes?
GuestDialogue.35: I heard someone singing near the orchard. It was pretty.#Do you know who it is?
GuestDialogue.36: Does Pika's have a delivery app?#If not, maybe I should make that recommendation.
GuestDialogue.37: I wonder if there is another way to reach the village besides the cable car.#Maybe a rollercoaster? That would be fun.
GuestDialogue.38: I couldn't sleep well last night. One of the guests was up all night talking about some kind of comic book.
GuestDialogue.39: Good that there is a grocery store here.#Imagine having to go to Pelican town for that!
GuestDialogue.40: I heard about the Pegasus incident, do you know what actually happened?
GuestDialogue.41: That robot running around near the cable car had a knife sticking out of it!#Does someone have a vendetta against that robot?
GuestDialogue.42: It's good to see that you have your own doctor here!#I was worried about having to go all the way to Pelican Town if there was an emergency.
GuestDialogue.43: Ugh, I can't believe there's a Jojamart all the way out here.#At least in Ridgeside we've got a local mom-and-pop available.
GuestDialogue.44: How did that truck in town get up here, anyway?
GuestDialogue.45: I'm attending an agricultural convention in Grampleton, so I wanted to stop by the local farms and check out their situations first.
GuestDialogue.46: So what's the local urban legends around here?#A kiwi that moves on its own? Seems weird, but okay.
GuestDialogue.47: I tried to give that turtle a piece of broccoflower, and it snapped at me!#More like a crab than a turtle, if you ask me.
GuestDialogue.48: A lot of people keep calling that pet in the doghouse a turtle.#Are we seeing the same creature? It's a tortoise!
GuestDialogue.49: I noticed there are some kids in this village, but no schools!#Homeschool or freedom?
GuestDialogue.50: I was walking past by the Blooming Hill farm and I saw a chicken outside the coop!#I hope it doesnt stay outside when it's dark.
GuestDialogue.51: I heard the Mayor talking about a very spicy romance book.#It sounded interesting tho!
GuestDialogue.52: Who do you think would win in a fight, the brunette at the restaurant or the purple-haired girl down in Pelican? They're both pretty buff.
GuestDialogue.53: I decided to try out my amateur radio setup while I was here, and I found someone else to talk to! He thought I was a pilot at first, haha.
GuestDialogue.54: My doc got me an appointment with a local physical therapist while I'm out here.#He was real good, but wouldn't stop talking about something called 'Incrediman'.#I was fascinated, but I still have no idea what it is, to be honest.
GuestDialogue.55: I saw some blonde girl in the woods to the south taking photos... think she has a portfolio?
GuestDialogue.56: I bet the stargazing here is amazing. Wish I brought my telescope!
GuestDialogue.57: That chicken wandering around town has such a sass to it.#Like, 'I'm a Strong, Independent Chicken, I don't need no society' vibes, don't you think?
GuestDialogue.58: I think I'm going to ask that cute janitor boy for his number.#Does he have a cell phone, you ask?#Who DOESN'T have a cell phone in this day and age?
GuestDialogue.59: This hotel doesn't have much in the way of entertainment, but the piano music is nice.
GuestDialogue.ModReference1: East Scarp?#It's okay, if you like birds.
GuestDialogue.ModReference2: Out of all the general stores around here, this town has the best one. That Pierre guy is a real trip. And don't get me started on Morris...
GuestDialogue.ModReference3: After I finish seeing the sites here, I'm going to go check out the towns south of here.#I hear Sunberry has amazing rainbows!
GuestDialogue.ModReference4: You meet the new tourist with the red hair? She's not much for conversation.
GuestDialogue.ModReference5: You know what this town needs?#More cats.
GuestDialogue.ModReference6: I heard there's some famous streamers that live around here.#I was wondering why they'd move all the way out here, but seeing the scenery, I get it.
GuestDialogue.ModReference7: I came here because I saw some of the local fishes at the nearby aquarium and just had to see them in the wild!
GuestDialogue.ModReference8: Who knew there was a LARP group all the way out in Pelican Town?#The redhead leading the group invited me for a sesh while I'm here.
GuestDialogue.ModReference9: That prophet on TV said I would have good luck today, but I started out with a hangover! Some prophet!
GuestDialogue.ModReference10: You watch 'True Paranormal Encounters'?#I just had to come out and see for myself after their 'mystery child ghost' episode!
GuestDialogue.ModReference11: I found some litter in the river, so I fished it out, and it was an autographed picture!#Who just throws stuff like that out?
GuestDialogue.ModReference12: That one Joja clerk looks so tired every time I'm in there. Working there must suck something fierce.
GuestDialogue.ModReference13: I took the bus through the desert to get here. While on the way, I thought I saw some big black dog among the sands.#Are there coyotes out here?
GuestDialogue.ModReference14: I heard there's a couple of cat cafes around here.#I wonder which has more cats to pet...
GuestDialogue.ModReference15: I swear I heard some motorcycle in the distance last night.#Who is out riding this late at night?#And how did they get up on the mountain, anyway?
GuestDialogue.ModReference16: I heard a story about ghosts in some abandoned house over at the East Scarp.#Is there anything like that over here at the Ridge?
GuestDialogue.ModReference17: I took a tour of the Pelican Town blacksmith shop, and the shopkeeper is so handsome, if a bit grumpy.#His bearded assistant isn't quite as easy on the eyes though.
GuestDialogue.ModReference18: I wonder who designed the buildings around here.#They all have a very cohesive look to them, don't you think?
GuestDialogue.ModReference19: I rescued a crow from the trash can outside and it chirped at me!#I didn't think crows did that.
GuestDialogue.ModReference20: I'm watching this reboot of some old show called 'I Love Lucy', but it's kind of weird.#Every episode, they change the laws of physics themselves.
GuestDialogue.ModReference21: Geez, what's a person got to do to get a decent pumpkin spice latte around here?#Does NO ONE have it?
GuestDialogue.ModReference22: That therapist was reading something called 'Rowdy Postapocalyse', said he got it from a neighbor.#Think it's any good?
GuestDialogue.ModReference23: The bartender in Pelican Town was telling me about the time one of his patrons put butter on a cat.#I'm SO telling the internet about this, haha!
GuestDialogue.ModReference24: They say if you go into Cindersap forest late at night, you might encounter a gray-masked hunter that's not of this world.#Scary? I think he sounds hot, honestly!
GuestDialogue.ModReference25: I saw a blonde girl sitting on the fence at that ranch in Pelican Town, watching the animals.#I guess it's a bit of a trek for her to come all the way up here, but those cows by the orchard are even cuter!
GuestDialogue.ModReference26: The fairs that happen here and in Pelican Town in the fall sound like so much fun. I wish there was one every week!
GuestDialogue.ModReference27: I'm an entomologist doing research on local conditions. The number of native species here is amazing!#Like, the number of moths alone could keep me cataloging for months!
GuestDialogue.ModReference28: How do the locals take care of such big farms? Haven't they heard of tractors?#At the least, they need some way to automate some of this!
GuestDialogue.ModReference29: One of the little kids showed me a doll that was made with local materials.#It was really cute, actually! The craftsmanship was so professional!
GuestDialogue.ModReference30: Have you heard of something called 'Blackstone'?#A local blacksmith asked me for some help researching it.
GuestDialogue.ModReference31: Agricultural technology has really come a long way.#The number of fertilizers they were selling in the store was far more than I expected.
GuestDialogue.ModReference32: Why do they call that summer festival in Pelican town a 'luau'?#It's really more of a potluck, isnt it?
GuestDialogue.ModReference33: The water around here is so clear! I think I can see every fish in the river!#Along with plenty of things that aren't fish, actually....
GuestDialogue.ModReference34: Horton, that's what I'm asking you: what the heck IS a thneed? 'A thing that everyone needs' tells me nothing!#Sorry, I'm on a business call.
GuestDialogue.ModReference35: So, if the locals have a list of tasks, is that a To-Dew list? Hahaha!#...Yeah, it was funnier when the ponytailed guy told it to me.
GuestDialogue.ModReference36: You're a farmer? Have you checked out that foreign flower seed catalog?#I think I might try cross-breeding some of their varieties.
GuestDialogue.ModReference37: I checked out the artifacts at the local museum. I think the spoon was my favorite.
GuestDialogue.ModReference38: I'm looking for the legendary 'pixie fruits'.#I heard they might be in this area, but I haven't had any luck at all....
Torts.NPC.cs.4276: *Smiles his most handsome smile yet**Disappointed birthday look*
Torts.NPC.cs.4279: *Disappointed birthday look**Sighs a long turtle sigh*
Torts.birthday.love.realm: %My "birthday"? Ah, yes, I remember that boy Yuuma making one up for me so he could celebrate it... Thank you, @. This is a lovely gift.
Torts.birthday.neutral.realm: %Although I do not have a true day of birth like you, I appreciate the gesture nonetheless, @.
Torts.birthday.hate.realm: %Although this birthday of mine is meaningless, @, I am well aware that your choice to offend me with this gift is not.
Festivals.EggFest.Bryle: Y'know? We don't have these wholesome gatherings back in the city!#$b#It's always nice to unwind and enjoy some egg-themed dishes.$h
Festivals.EoR.Bryle: Oh, hey @. Happy new year to you.$h#$b#I rarely visit for this festival because of the cold and the hike.#$b#But the lighting of the bonfire always makes it feel worth it.$h
Festivals.FlowerDance.Bryle: *Burp* Oh boy! I think I had too much Jello!$u#$b#And... are those flower petals inside it?$u
Festivals.Gathering.Bryle: The moment I arrived here, Jeric and the boys had me help them with their stall.#$b#Man, they really did procrastinate with that stuff! It was half-done just a few hours ago!$h
Festivals.IceFest.Bryle: Huh? Fishing?#$b#Nah! I'm hopeless with a fishing rod!$h#$b#So instead, I'll just watch the competition. Good luck out there.
Festivals.Luau.Bryle: The Governor told me to enjoy the festival and leave him be for a while.#$b#I'll comply, but I will still guard him closely to the best of my abilities.#$b#Oh! That reminds me!$a#$b#I better check the soup before he takes a sip!$a#$b#Better to be safe than sorry!$h
Festivals.Jellies.Bryle: *Sigh*$h#$b#I feel like it was a good idea to visit today.#$b#It feels 'just right' being here.$h#$b#You know what I mean?
Festivals.SpiritEve.Bryle: I think I like how this valley celebrates Spirit's Eve better than they do at the city.#$b#Back there, sometimes people get too wild and crazy with the parties.$a#$b#Yeah, they can be fun, but every year a bunch of incidents occur because of binge-drinking.$s#$b#*Sigh* It's a mess, I tell ya.$s
Festivals.WinterStar.Bryle: The celebration of giving, huh?#$b#Well, I'm already content seeing people safe and sound, especially my clients!$h#$b#What else could a bodyguard ask for?$h#$e#Haha! Nah, for real. I'm just glad I get to enjoy the holidays in a safe and quiet valley.$h
Festivals.StardewFair.Bryle: Man, I think the shooting game's rigged!$s#$b#I missed a bunch of shots! Nah! I just can't believe it!$h#$e#Oh well, at least the other games were fun enough for me to forget my miseries for a while.$h
Bryle.Dialogue.Mon8: Oh! Hey, @. Workng hard?#$b#Me? I've been polishing my gun shooting and boxing.$h#$b#I believe it's always good to be in tip-top shape as often as possible.$h
Bryle.Dialogue.Tue8: I've been visiting a lot more often, haven't I?#$b#Ah, well. What can I say? I've been enjoying my stay at this valley and the hospitality the locals bring.$h#$b#I also appreciate your company, @. You're fun to be around.$h
Bryle.Dialogue.Wed8: I've been considering staying at the Log Cabin Hotel in my next visit. Maybe if I want a little vacation?#$b#Hmm...$6#$b#Nah, I don't want to spoil myself too much!$h#$b#I might enjoy my stay here too much that I'll forget I have to guard the Governor!$h
Bryle.Dialogue.Thu8: The menu at Pika's is like its own game, huh? Like how they randomize it every day.#$b#It's fun though! It makes dining a little exciting.$h#$e#It's also nice to see familiar faces there.#$b#Sometimes I even get to listen to some of the stories from the locals I meet there!$h
Bryle.Dialogue.Fri8: Sometimes, I feel like I've involved myself with too much stuff and I'm in too deep with most of them that it feels bad to back out now.$u#$b#Like being an affiliate with the police force, having a bunch of politicians as clients for my security business, participating in MMA matches...$s#$b#*Sigh* What have I gotten myself into?$u
MovieData.Bryle.SpringMovie0.Love.AfterM: That was a fun one. Thanks for inviting me.
MovieData.Bryle.SummerMovie0.Like.Before: A movie about a video game? This sounds interesting.
MovieData.Bryle.SummerMovie0.Like.During: Oh hey, the action scenes are good!$h
MovieData.Bryle.SummerMovie0.Like.AfterM: I didn't expect it to be enjoyable. Thanks for the invite, @.
MovieData.Bryle.FallMovie0.Love.BeforeMo: Oh hey! A mystery movie, nice!
MovieData.Bryle.FallMovie0.Love.DuringMo: %Bryle seems to be focused on the movie.
MovieData.Bryle.FallMovie0.Love.AfterMov: Man, that was so good! Thanks for inviting me, @.
MovieData.Bryle.WinterMovie0.Like.AfterM: That moved me a bit. Thanks for the invite, @.
MovieData.Bryle.SpringMovie1.Love.Before: Oh hey, I like these movies!$h
MovieData.Bryle.SpringMovie1.Love.During: %Bryle seems to be enjoying the movie.
MovieData.Bryle.SpringMovie1.Love.AfterM: Man, that was so good! Thanks for inviting me, @.
MovieData.Bryle.SummerMovie1.Like.Before: A funny space movie? Sounds interesting.
MovieData.Bryle.SummerMovie1.Like.AfterM: That was cute and fun! Thanks for the invite, @.

event-75160453.75160453Brayle.32: My name's Jio.#$b#I'm part of the Following, also known as The Cult of the Lady with the Red Tail.#$b#We serve the Seer and the Fox.#$b#And we protect this realm from malicious spirits.$a#$b#Namely, the evil spirits under the command of Gabriella.$a
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.34: A powerful entity capable of unleashing destruction upon this realm.$a#$b#The higher spirits currently hold her at bay while the Following assists them in eliminating the invading spirits.#$b#But this evil entity is cunning.$7#$b#Recently, Gabriella's forces have started to infiltrate your goverment and other powerful human organizations.#$b#These people are evil to their core, and they will not cease until they have brought ruin to your civilization.#$b#They bring forth corruption right under your noses.$a
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.37: Your government, justice systems, most of your abstract infrastructure that holds your society together may have already been manipulated and corrupted from the inside.
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.38: And so, our forces identify, interrogate, and assassinate those politicians under Gabriella's power.#$b#In other words, we're the ones saving your people.$a
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.39: Regardless of your end goals, you're still not abiding by our laws.$a#$b#You're renegades.$a#$b#I'm sure our police force can handle this problem if you just cooperate with us.$a
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.40: As I just said, your organizations are infested with Gabriella's minions, detective.$a#$b#And we do not care about your "laws".#$b#They may well have already been tampered with by the agents of this evil.$a#$b#To turn ourselves in would be suicide.$a#$b#Not just for us, but for this realm as well.$a
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.41: Hmm...$7#$b#If what you say is true, then...$6#$b#Fine, but at least trust me, Jio.$a#$b#I'll agree to your terms and I'll keep your secrets.#$b#But cooperate with me alone, at least.$a#$b#I'll be your inside man. I have connections high and low in the government.
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.42: Hmm?#$b#You wish to assist our cause?#$b#Weren't you just trying to drag us all to prison?
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.43: Well, you and @ seem to be keeping all this a secret for a reason.#$b#And you made valid points earlier.#$b#All I want is the safety of the people I care about and the preservation of the peace.#$b#If you say our government may be compromised, then I'll adapt and work on another way to help.$a#$b#I want to assist you in rooting out the weeds inside the system, but I'll do it in a more sensible way, if possible.
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.44: A noble cause.#$b#And I don't sense any malicious intent from you.#$b#Hmm...#$b#Very well.#$b#I shall relay this proposal to my seniors.
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.46: Oh! And before you go.#$b#I have a question.
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.48: I just want to confirm.#$b#Is the governor I'm currently working for under Gabriella's influence?$a#$b#I need to know if he'll be safe or not.$a#$b#Along with the Ahn family. Are they involved?$a
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.49: Hmm...#$b#Based on recent investigations... this valley's governor is pure.#$b#So it's safe to say that he's not a target.#$b#Neither is the Ahn family.#$b#At least for now.
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.51: Well, then.#$b#I'll be contacting you soon.
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.53: Phew! That was a lot to unpack for one night!$h#$b#But, I'm glad to have learned of all this.#$b#Not to mention, how did you even get tangled up in all this mess in the first place, @?$6#$b#Wait, no. I feel like it's going to be another complicated story.$7#$b#You can hold on to that for now.#$b#I need time to process all these earth-shattering revelations.$u
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.54: Though, hey! I saw how you had my back earlier at the forest with all those monsters.#$b#I appreciate you looking out for me.$h#$b#Who knows what might've happened to me if you didn't follow me?#$b#So, thanks.
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.55: Anyway, I think I better get going.#$b#It's getting late and I need to rethink my approach to this whole ordeal.#$b#You should get some rest too, @.
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.56: Oh! And one last thing.#$b#Let's try not to involve Faye and Jeric in this, alright? Him and that princess already have plenty of stuff on their plate without the whole global conspiracy thing.#$b#So, let's give them the luxury of not having to worry about their own well-being while we save the world.$h#$b#Sound good to you?$h
event-75160453.75160453Brayle.57: Man... I better load up on ammo, huh?

event-75160456.02: Nothing~ I was just gonna ask if you're free tomorrow morning.#$b#Sooo... Are you free tomorrow?$8
event-75160456.03: Ah! I'm glad to hear that!$h#$b#Teehee < A surprise, sweetie!$h
event-75160456.04: Don't worry! It'll be fabulous!$h#$b#Trust me on this, okay?$l
event-75160456.06: Faye suddenly gave you a kiss!
event-75160456.07: It's going to be fabulously fun!$h
event-75160456.08: Nuh-uh! I'm not telling you the surprise! Teehee <$8
event-75160457.01: Good morning, sweetheart!$h#$b#Are you ready to go?
event-75160457.02: Where? Well it's a surprise anyway!$h#$b#Just bring some extra clothes! That's all you're gonna need.$h
event-75160457.04: We're going to be painting, sweetie!$h
event-75160457.05: Well, actually more like splashing some dye around!$h
event-75160457.06: I recently had an idea to create a new design out of a colorful fabric.#$b#But I just couldn't find the 'right' design, if you know what I mean.#$b#So I decided, what if I made one instead!$h#$b#Better yet, make it with my lovely sweetheart!$h
event-75160457.07: I brought a bunch of different colors for us to use.#$b#I figured we can splash these colors around and see what we can make!$h#$b#Ah! It's going to be fabulously lovely!$h
event-75160457.08: Teehee < I knew you'd go along with my idea.$8#$b#It's one of the things I love about you.$8
event-75160457.10: A little bit of red!#$b#Like my face when we kiss!$8
event-75160457.12: Ah! Orange! The color of excitement!$h#$b#Like how my life is every day with you!$8
event-75160457.13: And now the next color...#$b#Ah! Of course! Yellow!#$b#Cheerful and vibrant!#$b#Like my smile whenever I see you!$h
event-75160457.14: Oooh! Green!#$b#Like the beautiful crops you grow at the farm!$h#$b#...and my mind at bed sometimes. Teehee <$8
event-75160457.15: Next would be blue!#$b#Like I would be without you!$8
event-75160457.16: A bit of indigo!#$b#I like how it rhymes with 'I love you so so so!'$h
event-75160457.17: And for the final color...#$b#How about we do this one together?$h
event-75160457.18: And a touch of purple!$h#$b#A color I'd associate with how I feel when I'm in your arms...$8
event-75160457.19: Comfortable... Calm... and most of all...$l#$b#Fabulously grateful!$l#$b#Because I have someone who loves me for me...$l#$b#Cares for me and understands me...$l#$b#You're my inspiration to everything, sweetheart!$h#$b#I love you so so SO much!$8
event-75160457.20: It was a wonderful date with my wife.
event-75160457.21: Ah! I can't wait to finish this new design!$h
event-75160458.02: I looked like I was dazed out?#$b#Ah! My bad! I was just thinking about something.
event-75160458.03: Honestly I think I'm just tired.$s#$b#But I'm glad you're here to comfort me.$l#$b#Your company alone already lifts me up.$h
event-75160458.04: Hey, are you busy tonight?#$b#I was thinking we have a late night stroll and visit the cliff.$h#$b#Yesterday, Jeric told me the moon looks amazing when viewed from the cliff.#$b#I want to have this date with you, babe.$l#$b#So what do you say?
event-75160458.05: Great! I'll meet you here from 8PM onwards later then.$h#$b#Ah! I can't wait to unwind with you!$h
event-75160459.02: As we're riding the cable car...#Bryle looked at the shining lights of the distant city.
event-75160459.03: Heh.#$b#It's crazy that you can still see the city all the way out here!$h
event-75160459.04: You know...#$b#From far away, that place looks like paradise for some people.#$b#But growing up in the streets... It was often anything but paradise.$s#$b#As orphans, we grew up never certain for tomorrow.$s#$b#Just thankful we get by each day.$s#$b#I was a teen when I met Jeric.#$b#He was a little boy full of spirit!$h#$b#But he was alone, though that never bothered him, it bothered me.#$b#I see him as a little brother. And I just wanted to protect the little man.$h#$b#One day, he got a lucky break as his kind heart and smart wits landed him an opportunity!$h#$b#Events happened that led the Governor to adopt him. He's a charming rascal, so I wasn't surprised too much.$h#$b#I was happy for him! And so I wanted to make him proud of me as well.#$b#I worked hard, and was able to get gigs as security in different establishments.#$b#Eventually I was able to establish my own security firm! Man, I was so proud!$h#$b#I grew up seeing suffering. And so I wanted to be the one who can protect others from that suffering.#$b#It was a fulfilling job.$h#$b#Even Jeric got hold of this news, and he recommended us to the Governor. It was such a great opportunity.$h#$b#Oh! We're here!#$b#Heh. I got carried away talking about the past.$l
event-75160459.06: I just wanna say... I'm sorry if I'm not too good with romantic gestures.$s#$b#Nor with how I express my feelings...$s#$b#Honestly, I never would've thought I'd settle down.#$b#All my life, I always thought I'd be too busy protecting everyone else that I wouldn't have time for someone special.$s#$b#I devoted my life to work. To serve and protect.#$b#But now...#$b#I also devote my life to you.$l#$b#You give me motivation to do better.$h#$b#To protect the people who can lead this world to a better tomorrow.#$b#Because that way, our family's future will be happy and secure.$h#$b#Especially now we know about even greater powers that can harm this world.#$b#I know we'll stand strong together.$h#$b#For better and for worse.$l#$b#I'll always protect you and love you, @.$l
event-75160459.07: We spent a couple more hours just chatting under the moonlight.
event-75160459.08: We should have nightly strolls more often, huh babe?$h
event-75160460.01: I'm off to the city, babe.#$b#Don't wait up for me, I might be home late.#$b#Love ya!$h

Faye.MarriageDialogue.spring_1: Ah, isn't this the perfect weather?$4#$b#It's not too hot, and not too cold. All you need is a light jacket.$h

Faye.MarriageDialogue.summer_1: My, my. The heat's just not cooperating.$s#$b#Maybe I should sew a cooler dress.#$e#What design do you think would look great on me during heat waves, sweetheart?$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.summer_10: I'm thinking of making a grass skirt for tomorrow. Would you want to match with me, my little sweetheart?$h#$b#What? Haha, it'll be cute!$8
Faye.MarriageDialogue.summer_27: I'm excited about the festival tomorrow, @!$h#$b#It reminds me of a festival we have back home.$4#$e#Hey, maybe you'd like for us to do our own kind of thing after the festival tomorrow?$4#$b#I could make lanterns for us to use if you'd like.$4
Faye.MarriageDialogue.fall_1: Oh the autumn colors are just so wonderful! Isn't it, @?$h#$b#I have so many outfits in mind!$8
Faye.MarriageDialogue.fall_15: Sweetheart, have you prepared for tomorrow?#$b#Gosh, it's quite tiring to prepare for the fair.$6#$e#It makes me miss my handmaids from home sometimes.#$b#But it's honestly more fulfilling to do things on my own.$4#$e#It's even more fun when I do stuff with you though.$4
Faye.MarriageDialogue.fall_19: I'm really looking forward to tomorrow!$h#$b#I bet the girl's booth will sparkle far brighter than the boys'!$h#$b#Don't you think so, Sweetie?
Faye.MarriageDialogue.fall_26: Boo!$h#$b#Haha, did I spook you, sweetheart?#$b#Teehee, I'm excited to show-off my creation tomorrow!$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.winter_1: Ah-choo!$u#$b#Oh dear, the cold must be getting to me.$s#$e#I fear I'll never get used to the cold! It's like I'm allergic to it or something!$s
Faye.MarriageDialogue.winter_7: Sweetheart, don't forget to wear warm clothes tomorrow, okay?#$b#I'd like to hug you for good luck before the fishing contest but I won't hug you if you're too cold.$s#$b#So you have to be warm, okay?$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.winter_24: I'm really glad that we'll get to spend tomorrow together, @.$4#$b#Wear cute clothes to match mine, okay?$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Faye.1: Hmm, I'm thinking about rearranging the fabrics into chromatic order.#$b#It'll be more aesthetically pleasing to look at. Right, Sweetheart?$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Faye.2: I like how the room is brightly colored. It makes me feel less sleepy when I work!$8
Faye.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Faye.3: The spinning wheel in the corner is similar to the one at Miss Lola and Sir Freddie's house.#$b#Miss Lola has taught me different styles and told me so many tips for how to use it.$h#$b#She's so cool!$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Faye.4: Sweetheart, why don't you grab a snack and join me here?#$b#Just stay there, and I'll use you as my muse for some new designs!$8
Faye.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Faye.5: %Faye yawns.#$b#Oh my, sweetheart! You startled me!$u#$b#I was kind of daydreaming.$l#$e#I was daydreaming about our future - traveling and producing fashion shows together.$8#$b#It was nice.$l
Faye.MarriageDialogue.patio_Faye.1: %Faye is yawning while talking to you.#$b#Oh, here you are, sweetie!$6#$b#I've been looking all over for you.#$e#I wanted to get your opinion on some questions I'd been turning over.#$b#*yawns* But now that I think about it... I forgot what it was about.$6#$b#Yikes, my sleepiness gets me bad sometimes.$u
Faye.MarriageDialogue.patio_Faye.2: There's something about the outdoor breeze that's just...#$b#%Faye does the chef's kiss gesture.#$b#Perfect for wishful thinking, and daily affirmations.$8
Faye.MarriageDialogue.patio_Faye.3: I never imagined having a life as peaceful as this one.#$b#I'm glad I've been able to build this life with you, @.#$b#Thank you for supporting me in my dreams and for being the best partner anyone could ask for.$l
Faye.MarriageDialogue.patio_Faye.4: There's been some talk around the town that Haley's eyeing one of my designs to use for a pageant that she wants to join.#$b#It's so exciting, I can't wait to see if it's true.$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.patio_Faye.5: Sweetheart...$s#$b#I'm hungry...$s#$b#Can you make me some food?$8#$b#Pleeeeease?$l
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_0: %Faye yawns.#$b#What time is it, sweetie?$6#$b#Aww, time to get up again...$s#$e#Can we stay in for a bit? I'm still so tired from work yesterday.
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_1: Sweetie! Oh my, oh my, oh my!$h#$b#I'm thinking of making a little dress that's inspired by the rain.#$e#Imagine, a midnight blue dress that's close-fitting on top with a sweetheart neckline.#$b#Then a long mermaid skirt with little teardrop beads that are crawling up the edge.$4#$b#Oh, that would be so pretty to make! AND to use!$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_2: *yawns* It's raining again?$6#$b#My, this weather always gives me a bad case of the blues.$8
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_3: Sweetie, could you grab a jacket?#$e#Oh, not for me - It's for you to bring when you go out.$h#$b#So that you look fashionable while staying safe from the rain!$4
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_4: Hmm...$7#$b#Oh, I'm sorry, sweetie. I guess I must've dozed off while daydreaming about Irene's champurado.$8#$e#Last time I saw her, she told me that when it rains again, she'll cook me some. It's a delicious chocolate pudding from her hometown.$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_Faye: Ahh, the rain!$h#$b#I can stay in and design all day!$4#$e#If the rain doesn't put me to sleep again, that is.$8
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_0: *yawns* Come on, sweetie. Let's just sleep now, please?$6
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_1: How was your day, my little sweetheart?#$b#Did you have a great day?#$b#Tell me all about it!$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_2: Sweetie?$4#$b#I've been thinking about dreams lately...#$b#And I've been wondering what they mean as I've been having some crazy weird ones lately.#$e#Um... Could you cuddle me to sleep tonight, sweetie?$8
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_3: Hmm...$7#$b#Oops, I'm sorry, sweetie. I fell asleep while I was waiting for you.$8#$b#Let's go to bed now, okay? I feel really sleepy.$6
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_4: Sweetheart, have you been around the farm animals at night again?#$b#I'm just guessing because... Phe-ew, sweetie.$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_5: Sweetheart?#$b#Can we buy some shortcakes tomorrow?$4#$b#I've been thinking about it since this morning and I really can't wait to eat some!$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_Faye: Hello, my little sweetie!$h#$b#Were you able to get a lot done today, despite the rain?#$e#Why don't we settle by the fire and talk about your day over some s'mores?$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_0: My Yoba, sweetie!$u#$b#Did you know, last night a bird flew in through an open window!$u#$b#I was so shocked, but I covered my mouth so as to not wake you.$8#$e#It was something new, teehee. Kinda scary, but it feels amazing to experience.$4
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_1: You know something, sweetie? I didn't know that kettles whistle.$u#$b#At first I thought the sound I heard was a bomb, but I saw steam coming from the kettle. Then I realized that was the source of the sound I heard.$8#$e#The kettles at Pika's and back home didn't usually make a sound.#$b#I guess that's something new.$4
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_2: Oh, how cute!$h#$b#Sweetie, did you know that chickens sometimes go in the window to do their morning call?$h#$b#I say this because I woke up to a chicken in my face earlier.#$b#It was so funny!$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_3: *yawns* Hello, my little sweetheart.... Rise and shine!$6#$b#I'm so excited to go to work today. I love seeing customers come and go every day because it gives me fresh new ideas for designs.
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_4: It's crazy how things work around here.#$b#I really love it, @.$h#$b#Thanks for being patient with me all the time.$4
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_Faye: I'm thinking about making some curtains for our home, sweetie.#$b#What do you think? Any suggestions?
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_0: Whew! What a tiring day!$6#$b#How did your day go, sweetie?#$e#I had an exciting day today!$h#$b#Pika taught me how to skin some fish! It was so icky.$u#$b#But I had fun nevertheless.$h#$b#I enjoyed it so much that I got inspired to make a dress with scale-style edging!$8#$b#I can't wait to start sketching!$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_1: I fell asleep at the register again.$8#$b#It's a good thing that Pika is understanding about it all.#$e#I don't know why I'm so sleepy most of the time.$s
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_2: ...$7#$b#Oh, you're here now!$u#$b#I must've dozed off.$8#$e#Let's go to bed, sweetie? I'm awfully tired.$s
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_3: Trinnie went by the restaurant earlier, and she was talking about a princess-cyborg-ninja type of costume.#$b#Do you think I should make her one for the next Spirit's Eve festival?#$b#That would be fun to make!$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_4: Did you know I once had a smelly little cat?#$b#I used to ask her what she had been up to that made her so smelly.$u#$b#Oh, haha, that was so random. I just remembered that cat out of the blue.$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_Faye: Earlier, I was looking at the roof of Pika's and I noticed that the structure kind of looks like a skirt.#$b#I made some sketches of it during my break.$h#$b#But I'll show you those some other time. For now, let's go to bed! Hold me in your arms, @.$8
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_0: The breezy weather really makes me want to wear a flowy sundress.#$b#But by golly, wind can really yank up a skirt.$u#$b#It gets PG-13 sometimes.$8
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_1: %Faye starts yawning.#$b#Oh, hey, sweetheart!$6#$b#Pika told me that I needed to walk for a bit because I kept on yawning and it was getting contagious.$8
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_2: I've been here in the village for quite some time now, but I have yet to get used to the early mornings.$8#$b#You'll help me, won't you, sweetheart?$4
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_3: Sweetheart...#$b#Have you been out "adventuring" again?$8#$e#Oh, it's nothing, really. It's just that you smell, kind of... earthy.$4#$b#It's nothing bad, though.$4#$b#I have some oils and scents that my parents sent from home if you'd like any, sweetheart.
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_4: Did you bring any snacks, sweetheart?#$b#I'm kind of hungry right now.$s
Faye.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Faye.1: Goodbye, my sweetie!$h#$b#I'm off for today, so be a good little sweetheart for me, okay?
Faye.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Faye.2: I must be off, sweetie!#$b#I'll be looking for more colorful inspiration outside.$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Faye.3: I'll see you later, Sweetheart!$h#$b#Drop by when you can, please. I really miss you throughout the day.$4
Faye.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Faye.4: Annyeong, my sweetie! I'll see you later!#$b#I'll try to bring some midnight snacks for us to eat when I get home.$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Faye.5: %Faye yawns.#$b#*sigh* I still feel sleepy, @.$6#$b#But I really need to go out or I'm going to be late.$u
Faye.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Faye.1: Hello, sweetheart! How was exploring today?#$b#Did you miss me?$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Faye.2: Welcome home, sweetheart!$h#$b#*yawn* I've been craving our bed since this morning.$6#$b#Let's change into our sleep clothes and cuddle, okay?$8
Faye.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Faye.3: *yawn* Oh hello, Sweetheart.$6#$b#I feel so tired today.$s#$b#I guess the walks around the village got to me... I was used to riding bikes and scooters at home with my parents.#$b#Anyway, how was your day?$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Faye.4: %Faye seems to be asleep.#$b#Zzz...$7#$b#Whoops! Oh, hey, sweetie!$6#$b#I'm sorry - I must've dozed off while walking.$8#$b#Gosh, I've got to start drinking coffee or something.$h
Faye.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Faye.5: Ahh! Home at last!$h#$b#I miss you!$4#$b#Can we cuddle in bed, please?

Faye.MarriageDialogue.Good_0: Ooh! Sweetie! We could make crochet outfits for our next date night!$h#$b#Would you like me to teach you how?
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Good_1: I've been thinking up some cute little projects to decorate our home.#$b#Do you think little dresses for the lamp or a tablecloth would look good?$h

Faye.MarriageDialogue.Good_7: You're the bestest partner anyone could ask for, sweetie!$h#$b#I'm so happy you're mine!$h#$e#Oh, it's just that I dreamt that we won a marathon last night because you carried me on my back.$8#$b#It was so romantic!$4
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Good_8: Sweetie...$s#$b#I cut myself with scissors.$s#$b$Can you give me a kiss to make it better?$8

Faye.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_0: I've been finding nutshells in my pocket whenever I wake up from my naps.$u#$b#I'm really confused as to where they came from.$u#$e#It's either I'm starting to sleep-eat, or little Keahi's playing one of his pranks on me again.$8

Faye.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_3: Mr. Pika said that I can be able to bring home some produce that was about to go bad.$h#$b#Maybe you can use it to cook something for me soon, sweetie?$4
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_4: I feel so hot right now, I don't know why.$u#$b#Others are saying that it's quite cold...#$b#But it's really quite hot for me.$s

Faye.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_9: I'm kind of sleepy.#$b#Take a little break with me?$4
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Bad_0: I don't know why you must always be so cross.$a#$b#You're just annoying me now.$a
Faye.MarriageDialogue.Bad_2: If I knew you were like this, I would've just stayed with my parents.$a

I've got to make time to arrange the papers on my desk and my corkboard.#$b#Sheesh, maybe I need to find a new organization method soon.

Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_2: Oy, some weather we're having.$u#$b#Bet I can think of something better that we could do together.$l
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_3: Dang, this rain just won't let up.$u#$b#Sheesh.$u
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_4: *sigh* The mats at the community gym in the city get wet during rainy season.$s#$b#I wonder if it's okay that I use the gym at the Ridgeside Cabin Hotel.#$e#But the MMA ring at the community gym is still much better.$s#$b#*sigh* It's sad.$s

Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_Bryle: Babe, don't stay out in the rain too long, aight?#$b#I'm going to check around the farm in a while. I just need to double-check the perimeter. Just to be sure.
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_0: Ah, it's a great day.#$b#And it'll be even greater if you keep your nose out of trouble, babe.$6#$e#Seriously, I love you. But you've got to be extra careful, okay?
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_1: There's been talks about new organizations planning a coup on the governor.$a#$b#Babe, you have to stay alert and vigilant in the next few days, okay?#$b#We don't know if these people will also put a target on my back, so it's best to stay alert. Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_2: How was your adventure today, babe?#$b#Maybe I could come along next time?$l#$e#I mean, someone's got to protect you, y'know.$6#$b#And who better to do that than me?$h#$b#Haha, just kidding. Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_0: Did you know that in most emergencies it's safer outdoors rather than in?#$b#But even if it's safer out here, please be extra careful.$6#$b#You're so clumsy sometimes, I wouldn't put it past you to trip on a flat road.$7#$e#Joke!$h#$b#Well, I mean, I'm only half-joking because you do have to take care of yourself. Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_4: Can we just talk about how nice the weather is right now?#$b#Comfort weather for me!$h#$e#What about you, babe? Do you like this kind of weather?

Bryle.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Bryle.4: Ah, home at last. I never would have thought that I'd find home in you, @.$l
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Bryle.5: Now there's my precious babe.$l#$b#What did you do today? Were you able to kick some ass?$h
