Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Good_9: Heya, good lookin'.$h#$b#I'm really glad that you're part of my life babe.$l
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_0: Miss Lola and Sir Freddie approached me earlier, and we talked about how self-defense classes could benefit the community.#$b#I think it'd be a great way to promote safety as well as health in our town.
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_1: Jeric says that I'm a bit strict with you... I'm sorry.$s#$b#Sometimes I can't help it, because I just want to keep you safe.$l#$b#If I ever cross a line, please let me know, okay?$s
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_2: Trinnie and Keahi have been asking me to teach them to "hiyah!"$u#$b#Sheesh, those kids have got to learn how to chill first before they learn to fight, or else they might end up with something broken.$u#$e#Much like someone I know...$6#$b#Haha, I'm kidding babe!$h
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_3: There are times that the day feels kinda bummer.$s#$b#I don't know, but it's just a meh day today.$s
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_4: Sheesh, the week's been so busy.$6#$b#It's getting crazy because the governor's new security recruits are kind of, well...$u#$b#It's a bit hard to train them, unlike the other batches.
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_5: Hey babe, have you been practicing the combat skills that I've taught you?#$b#Those are important for your safety, you know.
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_6: What do you think about making bastons for arnis with me, babe?#$b#I could teach you a few moves and we can kick ass at the Ridge and you can help me look for the red-scarved people.
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_7: %Bryle looks like his head is somewhere in the clouds.#$b#Oh, yeah babe?#$b#I was just thinking about how to install CCTV cameras around our farm.
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_8: Babe, would you like some of these fish tacos?[213]#$b#Keahi said they'll blow your mind.$h
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_9: It's nice how Miss Lola and Sir Freddie are involved in the safety talks for the town.#$b#I never thought of them as the type, you know?
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Bad_0: Wow, you look like you've been through something rough.$u#$b#Would it be so bad to look in the mirror every once in a while?$6
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Bad_1: Ugh, can you not bother me?$7#$b#I have a lot of stuff to do.$a
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Bad_3: Can you please stop?$6#$b#You're acting pathetic.$7
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Bad_4: I really don't like it when you keep pestering me, you know?$7
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Bad_5: One day you talk to me like I'm the love of your life, then the next you act like I'm nothing to you?$7#$b#Oy Yoba, you really can't make up your mind, can you?$a
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Bad_6: I'm tired of fighting, so can you please just... Ugh!$a#$b#Stay away!$7
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Bad_7: I haven't really thought about you today, and I would like to keep it that way.$6#$b#Please remove yourself from my vicinity.$7
Bryle.MarriageDialogue.Bad_8: This is crazy!$a#$b#Wait, no. You're the one who's crazy!$a#$b#Not to mention clumsy.$6
Festivals.EggFest.Bryle_spouse: Hmm, the governor used to come to this festival, but then his spring schedule got too tight.#$b#I'm just lucky that I can spend it with you, though.$h
Festivals.FlowerDance.Bryle_spouse: I've already got my toes padded up in case you step on me, babe. So don't worry!$6#$b#Haha, in all seriousness, though - Save me all your dances, babe.$l
Festivals.Luau.Bryle_spouse: I've got people surrounding the governor.#$b#And someone is with him at all times, especially his tastetester.#$b#So stick by me, 'cause we have to let the tester do their test first to make sure it's not laced with poison, alright?$7
Festivals.Jellies.Bryle_spouse: Hmm, maybe next year we could place more fairy lights on the entrance to make sure that we can see everyone entering.#$b#You know, for everybody's safety.
Festivals.StardewFair.Bryle_spouse: I really do hope you'll be careful, babe.$6#$b#But also make sure you have fun, alright? Love ya!
Festivals.SpiritEve.Bryle_spouse: Spooky nights like this make me want to bring you home and cuddle you in front of the fire.$l#$b#I can't wait to carry you home, babe.$l
Festivals.IceFest.Bryle_spouse: Careful!$7#$b#You might fall in the holes...$6#$b#I love you, but if you turn to ice...$u#$b#Well, I'll warm you up in front of the fire and say "I told you so", haha!$h
Festivals.WinterStar.Bryle_spouse: I really don't have much to wish for now that you're here, babe.$l
Festivals.Gathering.Bryle_spouse: Man. Corine and Ysa are fired up over there.$h#$b#It's funny how people get so competitive over this.
Festivals.EoR.Bryle_spouse: One resolution of mine for next year is to be a better person and a better partner to you, babe.$l#$b#Thank you for coming into my life.$h
Bryle.Dialogue.Mon8.dating: Hey babe, miss me?#$b#I'd like to give you something... Something precious like you.[529]$l#$b#I found it during my work days, and I instantly thought of my crazy, clumsy, and precious babe.$l
Bryle.Dialogue.Tue8.dating: Hey babe. Always remember to watch your step okay?#$b#During my last work trip, there were people who got impaled because they stepped on traps made by terrorists.$7
Bryle.Dialogue.Wed8.dating: Jeric has been telling me to 'spice up' up my wardrobe.$u#$b#Sheesh, what do I look like? A clown?$6
Bryle.Dialogue.Thu8.dating: Hey my little bundle of uncoordinated grace.$h#$b#Haha, I was just teasing babe.$h#$b#How have you been?
Bryle.Dialogue.Fri8.dating: Babe! Look at this![536]#$b#I found this in the mountains. We could open it together.
Bryle.Dialogue.Sat8.dating: Babe, would you like some 'us' time next week?#$e#Hehe, it's my little way of asking you on a date with me.$l
Bryle.Dialogue.Sun8.dating: %Bryle holds your hand.#$b#I miss this, babe.#$b#How are you?
Bryle.Dialogue.Resort_Entering: Not too shabby.#$b#Let me do a perimeter check around the area to make sure we're safe.
Bryle.Dialogue.Resort_Leaving: Oh man, we gotta go home already?$s#$e#*Sigh*Just as I was starting to relax.$s
Bryle.Dialogue.Resort_Shore: You know, I really like the waves.#$b#It's very calming and nice...$h
Bryle.Dialogue.Resort_Bar: Non-alcoholic drink for me, I've got to stay alert in case something happens.
Bryle.Dialogue.Resort: It's nice to get away from the town to relax at the beach every once in a while.#$b#The stress from work really gets to me at times and ugh. Getting to spend some time with you is just a big blessing.$h
Bryle.Dialogue.MovieInvitation: Nice, alright!$h#$b#I'll meet you in front of the cinema. I just have to check on some things.
Bryle.Dialogue.breakUp: Psh, I felt that this wasn't working for a while now.$7#$b#Boy am I glad to be rid of the bad luck in my life.$6
Bryle.Dialogue.danceRejection: Sorry, I have to be on guard for this festival today.
Romance.Engagement.Bryle0: Really, babe?#$b#Are you sure you want me?$l#$b#Well of course I'll marry you!$h
Romance.Engagement.Bryle1: Sheesh, are you sure you're ready for a life of combat talks and safety measures?$u#$b#Really??$l#$b#Of course I accept, babe!$h
Romance.give.flowersA.Bryle: You really wanna lock me in and make sure I'm yours, huh.$h#$b#I love you too, babe!
Romance.give.flowersB.Bryle: Yes!#$b#I can't believe you want me to be yours...$l#$b#Man, I hope you don't get tired of me.$l
Romance.stardrop.gift.Bryle: Hey, babe. I just wanted to say... Thanks, for being my pillar that supports me no matter what. I got you this, I hope you like it!$l
Romance.rejectNPCA.Bryle: Uh, I don't think we even know each other that well.$6
Romance.MovieInvite.Spouse.Bryle: Yay, let's go babe!$h#$b#We'll meet each other at the cinema. I have to go get some things first.
Faye.Dialogue.Mon8.dating: It's a nice day today, isn't it.#$b#And I'm really glad that I get to see you even for a little while.$4
Faye.Dialogue.Tue8.dating: Can't get enough of me, can you?$8#$e#Why don't you tag along with me today?#$b#I could use you as my human pillow!$h
Faye.Dialogue.Wed8.dating: Hello there my little Sweetheart!$h#$b#Boy, am I glad to see you!$h#$b#Can I get a hug? I just need to recharge.$8
Faye.Dialogue.Thu8.dating: I believe we saw each other earlier, am I right?#$b#Or did I have a dream about you again?$4#$e#My, my, you're even with me in my dreams. You must've been thinking about me deeply!$8
Faye.Dialogue.Fri8.dating: Yay, it's the end of the week! What shall we do over the weekend, Sweetie?$4
Faye.Dialogue.Sat8.dating: I'm feeling quite inspired to create a parasol for you.#$b#If I have the time to make it, will you help me?
Faye.Dialogue.Sun8.dating: I haven't put much thought into buying a torch blower.#$b#But I'm quite the hazard for these things as I am called 'Little Miss can't bake to save her life'$h
Faye.Dialogue.Mon10.dating: I find it amazing how you manage to wake up every day and be this energetic.#$b#I just love that about you!$8
Faye.Dialogue.Tue10.dating: Have you thought about where you'd wanna live with me in the future?#$b#I was thinking maybe the suburbs, or somewhere close to the city!$h#$e#Oh I'm sorry.$8#$b#I'm just rambling on about the future, I might be scaring you off.$8
Faye.Dialogue.Wed10.dating: Hmm?$6#$b#Oh, hey Sweetheart I didn't see you there.$8#$b#I missed you!
Faye.Dialogue.Thu10.dating: I had a dream about you last night!$h#$b#We were strolling in the city and trying out different food stalls all day!$8
Faye.Dialogue.Fri10.dating: Pika's been telling me that he wants to make a delicacy from my hometown.#$b#I mean I love eating it, but I don't quite know how it's made.$s#$b#So now I'm just the taste tester.$h
Faye.Dialogue.Sat10.dating: Hello my Sweetheart, what have you been up to today?#$b#Think I can steal a kiss from you?$4
Faye.Dialogue.Sun10.dating: Pika and Keahi have been telling me how cute we look together.$4#$b#They're most certainly right, don't you think?$h
Faye.Dialogue.breakUp: *Sigh* You're just too much for me.$s#$b#I hoped we could work but what can I say...$s
Faye.Dialogue.danceRejection: Uh, no thank you.$u#$b#I'm fine here watching the parade of dresses in front of me.
Faye.Dialogue.divorced: I despise you more than I despise early mornings!$a
Romance.Engagement.Faye0: Really? You really want me?$h#$b#Why of course I'd marry you!$4
Romance.Engagement.Faye1: Oh my Yoba!$8#$b#Of course I'd marry you!$h
Romance.give.flowersA.Faye: For me? Really?$8#$b#I never would have thought, but I'm so glad you like me!$4
Romance.give.flowersB.Faye: This is so sweet of you!$4#$b#Now, can I call you Sweetheart?$8
Romance.stardrop.gift.Faye: You're my most fabulously amazing partner, my sweetheart. So take this as a token of my gratitude for all the love and joy you've given me!$l
Romance.rejectNPCA.Faye: We don't even know each other too well...$u
Romance.rejectNPCB.Faye: Err, I don't think so.$u#$b#Maybe we should get to know each other before anything else.$u
Romance.MovieInvite.Spouse.Faye: Ooh, I'd love to go to the movies with you!$h#$b#I always feel refreshed after the movies.$8
event-75160454.04: Faye almost fell down as she makes her way through the mess.
event-75160454.05: Whoops! It's quite a mess in here, huh?$8#$b#*Yawn* I swear it wasn't this messy earlier.$6
event-75160454.07: Sleepy? Me? Of course no-*yawn*$6#$b#-I'm not sleepy...$6#$b#...$7
event-75160454.10: Okay! okay! Maybe I stayed up all night again last night...$8#$b#But sweeetieeee!$s#$b#I was inspired, you see?$h#$b#That's why I'm working on a new design now!$h
event-75160454.11: I promise I'll work on this first, then I'll take a nap!$h
event-75160454.12: Now come give me a power hug!$h#$b#I'm sure I'll wake up when you embrace me. Teehee <$8
event-75160454.13: Faye suddenly gave you a kiss.
event-75160454.14: Well, of course a surprise kiss from me!$h#$b#And many many MANY more kisses!$l
event-75160454.15: Faye gave a bunch more kisses!
event-75160454.16: *Yawn* Ah! I love you so so SO much, sweetie!$l
event-75160454.17: Faye fell asleep in your arms.
event-75160454.18: Mhmm... I promise I'll finish this then we can be alone...$7#$b#...*snore*$7
event-75160454.19: I better carry her to her room.
event-75160454.21: AH! I fell asleep!$3#$b#Sweeetieeee! Why didn't you wake me up!$s#$b#Hmph! You better make it up to me now!$8#$b#Cuddle me here in bed now or else! Hmph!$8
event-75160454.22: I can't believe I fell asleep in your arms while we're standing! Ah! I must be so comfortable in your arms.$8
event-75160455.01: Good morning, gorgeous.$h#$b#So... Uh... I came by because I wanted to give you this.$l#$b#It's a little care package.$h
event-75160455.02: I know I'm often busy and because of that we don't get to spend much time together.$s#$b#So I arranged this little gift mostly of stuff that I hope can help you in your work and adventures.[241] [241] [241]#$b#And here...[349] [349] [349]#$b#Oh! And this one too.[253] [253] [253]
event-75160455.03: I hope these stuff can help you out.#$b#I wish I can stay by your side often so I can protect and help you out.$s#$b#But I know you can take care of yourself just fine.$l#$b#I'm just maybe a bit over-protective.$h
event-75160455.06: A goodluck kiss for the road!$h#$b#I'll see you later, babe!$h#$b#Love ya!$h
event-75160455.07: Take care of yourself, alright? I don't want you getting hurt!
Faye.summit.1: Sweetheart! This fabulous view is giving me so much inspiration!$h#$b#Ah! It's breathtaking!$h
Faye.summit.2: But of course, nothing could ever compare to the most fabulously beautiful view I know...$l#$b#And that's your smile, sweetie!$l#$b#I just can't help but adore our love and life together.$l#$b#Ah! I love you so so SO much!$h
Bryle.summit.1: Phew! What a view!#$b#And that breeze! Sheesh!$h
Bryle.summit.2: You know, babe?#$b#Thinking about it... I can't believe how much we've both been through.#$b#Through many of our own trials and tests, we persevered.#$b#Especially you!$h#$b#You're the most strongest, hardworking, and kindest person I've ever met!#$b#You're simply amazing, babe.$l#$b#I'm proud of you!$h#$b#And always remember... I'll always be here whenever you need a helping hand, alright?$h
event-94621001.01: Honey! You came to greet me?$8#$b#That's so cute... You're so cute, @...$4
event-94621001.02: I wish I could stay and talk to you more, but I'm supposed to be at the hotel by seven o'clock...$s#$b#Oh, I know - Why don't you accompany me there? It's not too long a walk, but the more time I get to spend with you, the better.$1
event-94621001.03: (Walk with June to the hotel?)#Sure, I'd love to!#Sorry, I can't...
event-94621001.04: Really? You will? Thank you so much, honey...$4#$b#Well then, let's go! The village awaits!$8
event-94621001.05: So how have you been, @?$8 I've been missing you like crazy, but you already knew that.$8
event-94621001.06: #Things have been well!#Awful! I missed you so much...#I'm much better now that you're here...
event-94621001.07: I'm so glad to hear that, honey. You've no idea what a relief it is...$1#$b#The only thing possibly worse than being apart from you would be you suffering the whole while and me unable to do anything about it...$s#$b#But I always knew you were so much stronger than that.$4
event-94621001.08: Oh, my poor baby! I felt the same...$7#$b#But I'm here now, and that's all that matters - right?$4
event-94621001.09: Trust me, dear, the feeling is mutual... You wouldn't believe how hard it's been without you all this time.$4#$b#In fact, swing by the hotel tonight and maybe I can show you exactly how hard...$9
event-94621001.10: Oh, by the way - Did you get the letters I sent you?$1
event-94621001.12: Good!$8#$b#I hope you liked them... Writing letters to you was just the only way I could deal with being apart from you for so long...$s#$b#But even that is no replacement for being here by your side again.$4
event-94621001.13: Wait, you didn't? Oh, no - Maybe they got lost in the mail...$7#$b#Well then, I guess I'll have to just recount everything I wrote to you in person.$8#$b#Not now, though. We'll have more important things to get to first, won't we?$l
event-94621001.14: Whoops! I keep getting distracted talking to you...$4#$b#But I really don't have the time to spare - Richard's expecting me soon, after all...$s#$b#So... let's get going, yeah?$1
event-94621001.15: Wow, the valley looks even more beautiful than I remembered...$8#$b#And it's certainly not the only thing...$4
event-94621001.16: Ugh, this is so frustrating...$s#$b#I wish I could just spend all day with you - holding you in my arms as you tell me every bit of what you were up to while I was gone, down to the very last detail...$4#$b#...But as soon as I get back to the hotel, Richard will be waiting for me, and then it's back to work, yet again...$s#$b#I wish I could just hit the snooze button on life for a moment, and devote it to getting back even a fraction of the time we've been apart...$s
event-94621001.18: Oh no, honey! The cable car suddenly malfunctioned and came to a stop while I was on my way to the village...$8#$b#I guess we'll be stuck here until it's fixed, huh? Could be an hour, maybe more...$9#$b#Some rotten luck we must have, huh? Oh well, nothing we can do...$8
event-94621001.19: Now, then... However shall we pass the time?$9
event-94621001.20: %June grabs you by the waist and pulls you close.#$b#You know, @... I think I might have an idea or two...$9
event-94621001.21: That was quite the warm welcome you gave me, @. If that's how you're going to greet me, maybe I should leave town more often...?$9#$b#Just kidding! Don't worry, honey - I'm not going anywhere, promise.$4#$b#Oh! Also, if anyone asks, the emergency stop lever pulled itself, okay?$8
event-94621001.22: No worries, honey. I know you're plenty busy with the farm...$1#$b#But please come see me when you get a chance, okay? There's so much I want to hear about...$4#$b#Well, I won't keep you. Thanks again for coming to see me, @. See you around.$8
event-94621001.23: There you are! Did you take care of everything on the farm?$8#$b#I missed you so much, @... It's so wonderful to see you again.$4
june_return.Richard: Ah, @! I heard from June about the cable car breaking down earlier today - Hopefully you're not hurt?#$b#...Is that so? And here I thought there must've been an impact of some kind, given all those bruises on your neck...#$b#Well, must be one of life's great mysteries, hm?$1
june_return.Daia-r1: You have some explaining to do, @... I heard you christened the cable car with someone other than me, your adorable-yet-sexy wife!$8#$b#So fess up - Who was it then?$a#$b#June? Ooh... I always knew you had good taste. After all, you did marry me <$7#$b#Alright. I'll forgive you - but next time you go for a cable car ride, let's go all three of us and enjoy a different type of ride, okay?$6
event-94621000.01: Oh, hi Yuuma!$h#$b#You're a bit late today, huh? I actually just finished my shift.$h
event-94621000.02: ...Oh, um, no worries, Mr. Choi. I just came to... visit my mother, is all...$2#$b#...$2#$b#...But, does that mean you're done playing piano for the day?$2
event-94621000.03: Well, it means I'm done getting paid to play piano, yes.$h#$b#But I don't mind playing a bit more if you'd like to hear it.$h
event-94621000.04: O-Oh, yes, please... If that's okay...$h
event-94621000.06: So, what would you like to hear?$h
event-94621000.07: Um, I don't know... What you usually play is always nice...
event-94621000.09: Y'know, Yuuma... I always see you coming here every Sunday to watch me play.#$b#And Richard tells me that before I even came here, you would sometimes stop by just to look at the piano.#$b#Are you interested in playing, Yuuma? Would you like me to teach you how?
event-94621000.11: Of course! I wouldn't offer if I didn't mean it.$h#$b#How about we meet every Sunday after my shift ends?$h
event-94621000.12: ...#$b#...One second. I have to ask my mom.$2
event-94621000.14: Great! Then why don't you come sit next to me on the bench?$h
event-94621000.15: Thank you so much, Mr. Choi!$h
event-94621000.16: It's my pleasure, Yuuma.$h#$b#Now, see this key right here? This is called 'middle C'...
pianolessons.June: Hmm, I guess this means I can't go to the Saloon on Sunday nights anymore...$3#$b#But given the whole reason I came here in the first place, that's probably a good thing.$9
pianolessons.Yuuma: The piano is really cool. Did you know it's in the same family of musical instruments as the harp?
pianolessons.Naomi: I discussed rates with June, and he insisted that the lessons be free - So I told him he could help himself to the cafe's snacks, and he couldn't refuse.$1#$e#I'm just so grateful that Yuuma will have a chance to do something for himself.
pianolessons.Shiro: Yuuma told me all about how he can't wait to start piano lessons... I'm glad. I haven't seen him this excited in a long time.$1
lesson.1.Yuuma: Oh, I see! So C sharp is the same as D flat, right?$h
lesson.1.June: Exactly! It's a step above C, and a step below D!$h#$b#I've got to say, you're quite the quick learner, Yuuma.$h
lesson.2.Yuuma: Hmm... I don't know those people, but it sounds similar to a song I know by The Aphids.#$b#They're my dad's favorite band. He even saw them in college once.$h
lesson.2.June: So this four-chord progression is really common in modern music.$h#$b#Like in this Madam Lala song, or this one by Burgundy 4. Do you hear it?$h
lesson.3.Yuuma: Hm, that sounds a bit weird, I think...#$b#How about "Ezekiel's Garden Beer Draws Flies"?$1
lesson.3.June: A mnemonic device can be useful in memorizing the different staves.#$b#For example, the one I was taught for the treble clef was "Every Good Boy Deserves Fudge". But feel free to make up your own.$1
lesson.4.Yuuma: Oh, I don't need a piano, Mr. Choi. I just imagine the keys and pretend to play, like this.
lesson.4.June: You've memorized all the chords already? I'm impressed, Yuuma! Especially considering you don't have a piano to practice at home.$1
lesson.5.Yuuma: If it's alright, Mr. Choi, I'd like to skip the basic songs and just learn the ones I like.#$b#Could you teach me the IncrediMan theme song?
lesson.5.June: Okay, for your first full song, we should start with something simple... How about a nice Winter Star carol?#$e#Oh, um, sure! If you're ready for it, then so am I.
lesson.6.Yuuma: Mr. Choi, how did you know you wanted to play piano for a living?
lesson.6.June: Hmm, that's a good question, Yuuma...#$b#Well, I've always known that I want to play piano forever. And the best way to make sure I could do that was to do it for a living.#$b#It may not be on the level of doctor or lawyer, but at least I get to spend each day doing what I love.$1
lesson.7.Yuuma: Okay, Mr. Choi, but... I don't think knowing the names will help me when I can't reach the pedals anyway.$s
lesson.7.June: So, the leftmost pedal is called "una corda", or the soft pedal. The middle one is the sostenuto pedal, and the rightmost one is the sustaining pedal, or the damper.#$e#Oh, right... I'll look into getting a pedal extender for our lessons.$s
lesson.8.Yuuma: But Mr. Choi, how else am I supposed to reach all the keys? My hands aren't nearly as big as yours...$s
lesson.8.June: A lot of beginners try to stretch their hands out so that they can reach farther, but that just makes it harder to hit the right notes.#$b#What you want to do is keep your fingers slightly curved, like a claw motion, almost.
lesson.9.Yuuma: Two. Two halves make a whole. And two quarters make one half, and two eighths make one quarter, and two sixteenths make one eighth.
lesson.9.June: Okay, Yuuma, quiz time! A whole note corresponds to how many half notes together?$h#$e#...Yes, that's correct. I see Miss Penny is doing a good job of teaching fractions...$3
lesson.10.Yuuma: Four, five, and eight. And the major intervals are two, three, six, and seven, which is also the same as the minor.
lesson.10.June: Alright, since my last quiz was clearly too easy, I've prepared something a bit more challenging for today.$6#$b#In a major scale, which notes above the root are perfect intervals?#$e#...Man, Yuuma. I'm going to have to brush up on my music theory if I want to stump you, huh?$9
stage.Yuuma: Oh, hello.#$b#We're playing... Well, I'm not sure what we're playing, but it involves jumping, and I'm the ref.#$b#Would you like to join? You can play the winner next.$h
aqualab.Yuuma: Don't worry, Trinnie. I read a lot about fish, and if a Gotoroan blood-sucking poisonfish were real, I would've seen it in my fish encyclopedia.#$e#And Keahi, how would a fish from Gotoro even get all the way over here?$2
afterplaying.Yuuma: I had a good time with Trinnie and Keahi today. They're really funny!$h
stage.Keahi: Hiya! Take that!!#$b#Oh, hey @! We're playing air ninjas. Wanna join?$h#$e#If you wanna play, you have to be in the air, y'know. Everyone knows you can't play air ninjas on the ground!
stage.Keahi-withLouie: That's not allowed, Louie! That's no fair to anyone else.$a#$e#I don't need gravity to beat you! Watch this!$a
aqualab.Keahi: See that brown fish, guys? It's called a Gotoroan blood-sucking poisonfish, and if it even touches your skin, you'll be dead in two minutes!$h
stage.Trinnie: Check out this special move I made! It's called the Sparkling Ballerina Spin of Destruction!$h#$e#...Did you see it?$h
stage.Trinnie-withYuuma: Keahi!! I got you in the chest and you know it.$a#$b#C'mon, Yuuma! You're the ref, you saw! Tell him he's out!$a
aqualab.Trinnie: Mister @!! Mister @!!$2^Miss @!! Miss @!!$2#$b#Keahi says there's a Gototo-- Goroto-- ...scary bloody poisony fish in the river!$2#$b#But it's not real, right? He's lying, right??$2
aqualab.Trinnie.GN: {{Title}} @!! {{Title}} @!!$2#$b#Keahi says there's a Gototo-- Goroto-- ...scary bloody poisony fish in the river!$2#$b#But it's not real, right? He's lying, right??$2
stage.Louie: Actually, Keahi, I don't need to jump because I'm in a gravity bubble, so I'm always in the air.#$b#I'll let you have one too, if you let me win against you.
aqualab.Louie: I know all there is to know about Gotoroan blood-sucking poisonfish. My family has twelve of those in our aquarium!#$b#Chef Irene even makes them for dinner sometimes. If you guys ever come over, maybe I'll let you try one.
afterplaying.Louie: I like playing with all the other kids!$h#$b#...I hope they invite me to play next time, too.$s
Jio.summit.1: ...This world has never belonged to me, and yet I've never belonged to my own world. From my earliest memory, all I'd ever known was that desolate feeling.
Jio.summit.2: But since the moment I chose to devote my life to you, that cynical thought never crossed my mind again.#$b#What I am, what I'm supposed to be... None of that matters to me anymore. My values are no longer dictated by what others have and I lack.#$b#Whatever world has you in it - that's where I belong. Next to you, now and forever more.$9
Festivals.EggFest.Jio_spouse: This event is an excellent opportunity for the young ones to hone their tracking and observation skills from an early age.$8#$b#Of course, you are far too clever to find it more than a mere game, my beloved.$8#$b#Still, should you wish to participate, I would be happy to offer my aid.$1#$b#Perhaps I could put my skills in sabotage to use against the purple-haired one?
Festivals.FlowerDance.Jio_spouse: I have studied the steps of this "flower dance"to perfection. I am confident that I will be up to the task at hand.$8#$b#...I am also quite confident that I will pale in comparison to the unparalleled brilliance of your beauty, my flower.$9
Festivals.Luau.Jio_spouse: Kiwi is assisting me in ridding the soup of any potential poisonous agents, but...$s#$b#Well, should we fall, at least I will have died by my true love's side.$7
Festivals.Jellies.Jio_spouse: I asked Bliss to keep an eye on the flow of magic in this area tonight in my stead, so that I may experience this spectacle by your side.#$b#Although even now, I know that I have already laid eyes upon the most breathtaking sight there is this night.$9
Festivals.StardewFair.Jio_spouse: I understand that the competitions here are supposed to be fair, so I've begrudgingly left your competitors' stands alone.$7#$b#Still, since they do call this a "fair", I suppose there will be no complaints if I counteract the subterfuge some of these "games" are engaged in, correct?$1
Festivals.SpiritEve.Jio_spouse: Forgive me, my star, but I cannot come home tonight. There are far too many dangers lurking in the shadows who would use this liminal state to their advantage.$7#$b#But please don't be concerned, my moon. While I may have cared little for my own safety in the past, I would never dare let harm befall me now.#$b#After all, the only fate worse than death would be to make my beloved shed a tear over me.$s
Festivals.IceFest.Jio_spouse: Do you plan on taking part in the competition, my flame? Even if you choose to abstain, not a soul here would dare doubt your immeasurable talent at everything you do.$8#$b#...Or rather, they ought not dare...$7
Festivals.WinterStar.Jio_spouse: Truthfully, I never understood this so-called festival of gratitude... That is, until you came into my life, beloved.$l#$b#You are my greatest gift, my guiding light, my brightest star. I love you most ardently - more than you could ever possibly know.$9
Festivals.Gathering.Jio_spouse: A curious competition is happening in the marketplace. Do you plan to partake, my plum blossom?#$b#No? A wise decision, I wager. As they say, sometimes the only winning move is to not play.$1
Festivals.EoR.Jio_spouse: ...How strange. The local custom on this night is to make a wish, as if an exceptionally large fire plays any role in increasing its likelihood.#$b#If I have learned anything in my many years, it's that the best things in life are those you didn't even know existed... till one day they come wandering up into your neck of the ridge.$9
Romance.Engagement.Jio0: ...You wish to formalize our bond, then?$6#$b#My love... Yes, I accept. With every ounce of my being.$9#$b#Please, plum blossom, leave the arrangements to me. I will enlist Yoba himself to ensure everything is as you deserve.$1
Romance.Engagement.Jio1: ...You wish to formalize our bond, then?$6#$b#My love... Yes, I accept. With every ounce of my being.$9#$b#Please, plum blossom, leave the arrangements to me. I will enlist Yoba himself to ensure everything is as you deserve.$1
Romance.give.flowersA.Jio: You... wish to be with me? But I have... so little experience in matters of the heart...$2#$b#...$2#$b#...But I cannot deny that I have feelings for you, too, and intense ones at that...$l#$b#Very well. If you... truly wish to be with one as lacking as myself, the least I can do is give you an honest attempt in return.
Romance.give.flowersB.Jio: You... wish to be with me? But I have... so little experience in matters of the heart...$2#$b#...$2#$b#...But I cannot deny that I have feelings for you, too, and intense ones at that...$l#$b#Very well. If you... truly wish to be with one as lacking as myself, the least I can do is give you an honest attempt in return.
Romance.stardrop.gift.Jio: In this valley, it is said that this mysterious fruit can extend one's life beyond its natural limit. Of course, it is merely a legend, but...#$b#But if there is even a fraction of a chance that it is true, I would seek it a thousand times over just so that we may remain in each other's lives a second longer, my star.$9
Romance.rejectNPCA.Jio: @, I am far too busy to pursue romantic desires. Do you not also have things you wish to accomplish?
Romance.rejectNPCB.Jio: @, I am far too busy to pursue romantic desires. Do you not also have things you wish to accomplish?
Romance.MovieInvite.Spouse.Jio: I would be happy to accompany you on this mission, beloved, even if I do not understand its purpose.#$b#Wherever my star leads me, I will gladly follow.$1
Jio.Dialogue.Mon8: Ah, hello, @.$h#$b#It's, er... nice to see you, I suppose...$4
Jio.Dialogue.Tue8: Daia's shenanigans are simply too much to bear sometimes.$4#$b#I remember when she was still just a youth in training... She was so quiet back then.
Jio.Dialogue.Wed8: Hello, @. How is %farm Farm faring?#$b#I once read a novel about a family forced to travel westward when their farmland turned to dust...#$b#That sort of occurrence doesn't happen often, does it?$s
Jio.Dialogue.Thu8: Hello, @. What brings you here today?
Jio.Dialogue.Fri8: Kiwi spent all of last night's mission sulking...$s#$b#Most likely she's jealous of the newfound time I spend with you.#$b#She's not used to me having an actual friend, you see.
Jio.Dialogue.Sat8: Conversing regularly with you is proving to be most constructive for me.#$b#I'm not sure if you've noticed, but the way I speak is a tad... out-dated.$s#$b#I learned to speak a long time ago, and my patterns of speech still reflect that. I hope it's not a bother to you.$s
Jio.Dialogue.Sun8: I must confess, @. I've never been so close with someone outside the cult before.#$b#I find you... refreshingly ordinary.$h
Jio.Dialogue.Mon8_dating: This is... most unlike other missions I have undertaken, so please bear with my inexperience.$s
Jio.Dialogue.Tue8_dating: I have informed the Seer of our circumstances.#$b#She permitted it, but warned me not to let a relationship distract me from my mission...#$b#As if she's one to talk.$7
Jio.Dialogue.Wed8_dating: Pay Daia no mind. I am unsure if she is excessively curious, or simply jealous, but either way I have no reason to think she shall do you harm.#$b#...Kiwi, on the other hand...$s#$b#Well, just allow her some space to process this all, for the time being.
Jio.Dialogue.Thu8_dating: I wish to learn more about you, @... But alas, we are so different, I do not know where even to begin...$2
Jio.Dialogue.Fri8_dating: All I know of love is what I've gleaned from the poetry books among the Seer's collection of tomes...$s#$b#Whenever she caught me reading them, she would scold me and say they weren't worth my time...But is love worth so little?$s#$b#Or can she only utter such a thing because she's found love of her own?$s
Jio.Dialogue.Sat8_dating: As long as I can remember, I've been alone. And I preferred it that way. Kiwi has been a valued companion, of course, but...#$b#But now solitude feels like a chain around my neck. The quiet air that used to calm my nerves now sounds dead and hollow without your laugh permeating the stillness. Even when holding a knife, my hand feels empty without yours in it, tucked tight against me.$s#$b#Is this... Could this be... something true?$l
Jio.Dialogue.Sun8_dating: @, would you perhaps be willing to watch the sunrise with me some time?#$b#To see the dawn of this world reflected in your eyes, the morning's first rays caressing your skin, glistening off your smile...$9#$b#I don't know why, but I yearn for it.$l
Jio.Dialogue.Mon10: In poems, people refer to their lover in all sorts of ways... "my beloved", "my fair love", "my moon and stars"...#$b#But how am I to choose just one phrase when you are all of those things to me, and yet so much more?$7#$b#I did not expect love to be this perplexing.$s
Jio.Dialogue.Tue10: After agonizing over it it all night, I have decided that I will use whichever term of endearment I find best suits you in the moment.$1#$b#For instance, right now the soft blush of your cheeks make you look sweeter than the ripest plum, so I shall call you "my plum".$9
Jio.Dialogue.Wed10: Being with you... is changing me, my sun. Try as the recreant inside me might, there's simply no denying it.$l#$b#...No, "changing" is not quite an apt descriptor. Rather, you are unearthing parts of me that were buried so deep, I was unaware of their very existence.#$b#But now, under your tender care, they are blossoming, and for that I am eternally grateful.$h
Jio.Dialogue.Thu10: It's interesting, my rose... I never paid much attention to your ki outside of combat, but... now that I'm close enough to touch it, it fills me with a sense of euphoria I've never experienced before...$7#$b#...It's intoxicating. I want to hold you near and breathe it in till it chokes me.$9
Jio.Dialogue.Fri10: I spoke with the local psychologist for advice regarding relationships.#$b#I... failed to grasp a number of the terms she used. It seems I still lack training.$s#$b#Tell me, my love, what is "EQ", and how many bullseyes must I be able to hit to raise mine to an acceptable level?
Jio.Dialogue.Sat10: Do you... think about the future much, my sky? In the past, I always focused on the present mission alone, but...#$b#...But now I find myself wondering what sort of life might lie ahead of me, if I continue to walk this path by your side.$9
Jio.Dialogue.Sun10: Would you care for a bout of combat training, my heart's fire? Perhaps by the Falls, where it's more remote...?$8#$b#...Why? Well, I know you are plenty busy, but...$l#$b#Last night I dreamt that Gabriella had taken hold of you, and we fought till our breaths were ragged and our clothes tattered. After an endless struggle, I pinned you against the jagged cliffside, writhing in my arms like an animal caught in a trap, and then...$7#$b#...I woke up.$s#$b#So naturally, I awoke feeling terribly unsatisfied... And I suppose I was curious to find out what would've happened next... If you'll indulge me?$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spring_1: The lines of power have revived. I feel the energy of nature, pumping through my veins anew.$8#$b#Here, take my wrist, beloved. Do you not feel it, too?#$b#Perhaps all this energy needs to be released into an outlet of some kind... What do you think, my fire?$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spring_12: Kiwi is very fond of the festival tomorrow.#$b#I think the shape of the eggs remind her of herself.$8
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spring_23: %Jio is muttering to himself.#$b#Step, crouch, step, crouch, then a step forward...$7
Jio.MarriageDialogue.summer_1: I know you have a lot to do today, my sun. Do not hesitate to call me should you need assistance, but otherwise, I shall seek not to be a hindrance.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.summer_10: Do you need anything for our contribution to the communal soup tomorrow, my ocean? I am happy to search for suitable goods while I am out on reconnaissance.$8
Jio.MarriageDialogue.summer_27: According to the tomes I've read, the coming of the Lunaloos dates farther back than any existing text, meaning they've been here longer than written word itself.$1#$b#And in every rendition of the tale, no matter what peoples currently inhabited the valley, it is always said that occasion was regarded as the most romantic night of the year.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.fall_1: A true plethora of poems have been written about this season. My favorite one begins thusly:$8#$b#"Season of mists and mellow fruitfulness, close bosom-friend of the maturing sun; Conspiring with him how to load and bless, with fruit the vines that round the thatch-eves run."$h#$b#I used to read it and imagine a fantastical cottage from a nursery rhyme... But I no longer must use my imagination.$8#$b#It turns out such a place existed all along, here, as the home with which my true love has provided me... And the real thing is so much more splendorous.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.fall_15: Tomorrow's fair brings all sorts of colorful folk into town, my sunflower. I know better than any other how capable you are in combat, but...$7#$b#Please, promise to keep your guard up, if for no other reason than to grant me peace of mind.$s
Jio.MarriageDialogue.fall_26: I've always found the locals' custom of donning costumes tomorrow night most peculiar. Surely they don't think their shoddy disguises stand a chance at deceiving an evil spirit...?$7#$b#...That said, should you elect to join them in this tradition, well... I certainly wouldn't be opposed to seeing your choice of dress.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.winter_1: As the great powers of nature settle into the nadir beneath our feet, please remember that now is the time for energy to find its resting point and for life to take shelter and recuperate. Which includes you, my tireless little worker bee.#$b#Please, do not push yourself in such harsh conditions.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.winter_7: Despite its deceptively low altitude, this area is just as bitterly cold as the mountain's summit itself...$7#$b#My treasure, if you feel the slightest bit of chill tomorrow, you mustn't hesitate to let me know, alright? I won't have you risking frostbite in the name of some trivial competition.$a
Jio.MarriageDialogue.winter_17: Shall we investigate the market tonight, my lodestar? This market converges with the world of the unseen, so who knows what surprises might await us?$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.winter_24: Regarding this festival tomorrow... Even if I do not have you as my "secret friend", as it were, am I still allowed to present you with a gift before the tree?#$b#...And supposing it is not the type of gift meant for others' eyes... How would you like me to give it to you then, my desire?$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Jio.1: My angel, I've noticed that the locals here have an odd proclivity for showing up on your doorstep unannounced.#$b#I know they mean no harm, but please be wary of inviting them in.$s#$b#The unwavering trust you place in others is one of the traits of yours I've grown most fond of... But there are some beings out there who would take advantage of such a virtue, given the opportunity.$7
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Jio.2: Come here, my sunbeam. There's something I desire to show you...$1#$b#Do you see this piece of paper? It's silly, I know, but... This is the receipt from Pierre's, when you were kind enough to assist me all those moons ago.$l#$b#For some reason, I couldn't bring myself to throw it out... Now, finally, I know why.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Jio.3: Should you be curious, I would be happy to show you the contents of my drawers - but please note that what you find within may be dangerous to touch.#$b#Hm? Is something amusing, my love?
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Jio.4: A private space to call my own... It's new to me, but it's pleasant. Just like everything else in my life since you came into it, my blessing.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Jio.5: It's strange... Weapon maintenance has always been important to me - That much was drilled into all of us who grew up in the Cult.#$b#But here, I find myself sharpening my blades over and over like a man possessed, as if they might dull the moment I set them down.$7#$b#I suppose that preparedness is all the more crucial to me, now that I'm no longer protecting solely myself.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.1: My fire, might you be interested in a quick sparring session?$8#$b#That is, of course, if you're not too worn out from last night's, er... session.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.2: Those who are new to the Following often assume our training is purely physical, but new initiates cannot pick up a blade till they can meditate for three consecutive days.#$b#Neglecting one's mental fortitude is an all-too-common mistake - and a deadly one at that.$7
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.3: I cannot thank you enough for providing me with a training area to call my own, my divinity.$8#$b#...When I lived at the base, I tried to remove my shirt during practice - once. A grave mistake...$7#$b#Of course, that was also the day we learned of Daia's latent prowess as a sculptor.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.4: %Jio is meditating with his eyes closed.#$e#...You know I am eternally grateful for your attraction to my physique, my fairest, but it makes it rather difficult to channel my ki properly when you keep squeezing my bicep like a dog does its favorite toy.$8
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.5: Please pay me no mind, my daystar, and go about your morning tasks as usual.$8#$b#The commotion doesn't distract me in the slightest, no. On the contrary, I find it rather comforting to hear you working away by my side.$1#$b#It brings me more peace than meditation ever could.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.summer: Training beneath the sweltering summer sun fortifies the mind and improves overall resilience. By pushing the body past its natural limits, one may surpass any obstacle nature may pose.#$b#...That said, my disdain for the heat is one weakness I don't ever foresee myself overcoming.$7
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.winter: I appreciate your worry, my flame, but I speak earnestly when I say that the cold is no bother to me.$8#$b#On the contrary, the sensation of icy air rushing through my lungs heightens my awareness of my corporeal form.$h#$b#And if that reassurance does not yet suffice, then I promise to come ask you to warm me up by the fire, should I start to shiver. Alright, my love?$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_0: Yoba above– The rain makes your ki even more potent than usual - I can already feel it seeping into my skin...$6#$b#Wait, my poppy flower, I'm not done holding you quite yet. In fact, I don't think I can ever let go...$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_1: The Seer informed me that there are no missions requiring my presence today.$8#$b#In the past, that news would have caused me dismay, but now I find myself positively elated at the opportunity to spend the day at home with you.$1#$b#@, ruler of my heart and soul, would you grant my selfish request and stay by my side today?$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_2: Rain is one of the most sublime things this realm has to offer. Whatever the elven kingdom is like, I hope that this gentle song is as familiar to my compatriots' ears as it is to mine.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_3: There's a certain poem from my childhood, one I would recite to myself whenever I found myself marching in the pouring rain. It was a mantra, of sorts, to take my mind off the wet and cold.#$b#"I am the Poem of Earth... Eternal I rise impalpable out of the land and the bottomless sea, upward to heaven, whence, vaguely form'd, altogether changed, and yet the same, I descend..."#$b#...But speaking it aloud now, I can't help but think of the effect your love has had on me... "Altogether changed, and yet the same."$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_4: As a child in the Following, rain always dampened my spirits. It meant sleepless, shivering nights, wet clothes that stuck to skin like cement, monsters using its cover to ambush us...$s#$b#But now, with you, it means leisurely mornings in bed, tea by the fireplace... And in the evening, there's the smell of mist in your hair, droplets of water on your face for me to brush away with my lips...$9#$b#...Yes, this kind of rain is far superior, my harmony.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_Jio: Are you about to depart for the day? I apologize for not being able to accompany you.$s#$b#But upon your return, I hope you'll spare some time to tell me about your day - from start to finish, not leaving out a single detail. Is that understood, love?#$b#If for no other reason, then at least to let me listen to the melody of your voice that I'll be bereft of till then.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_0: The sound of the rain muffles any noise from our surroundings. Being unable to track my enemies' movements unnerves me, but...$7#$b#It also directs my focus entirely unto you.$8#$b#Well then, my fire... You have my undivided attention now, so come - Show me what you intend to do with it.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_1: Do you ever feel as if the rain is whispering its secrets to you amidst the downpour, my dearest?#$b#Listen carefully to its sighs... Can you hear it? How it urges me to take you in my arms and hold your body against mine, till the morning sun beckons us to wake...$9#$b#Well, darling, who am I to defy nature's decree?$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_2-1: There you are, my fairest. I brought this for you from my patrol in the Ridge Forest today.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_2-2: It is by no means as beautiful as you are, of course, but I hoped it might at least bring another dazzling smile to your face.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_3: Goodness, my love - You look wetter than an otter's pocket!$9#$b#Stay right where you are while I quickly warm up a towel to dry you off with, alright?$8
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_4: It felt as if an eternity passed while I awaited your return tonight, my love.$s#$b#Of course, since I had to wait my whole life just to cross paths with you, I suppose in a way it did.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_5: @, my love, safehaven of my heart...$9#$b#Tonight, I desire nothing more than to lay my head upon your breast and listen to the mellow harmony of your beating heart and the rain falling from above till it lulls me to sleep...$l#$b#...So please, may we retire early tonight?$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_Jio: Today's expedition in the forest has left me positively soaked to the bone...$s#$b#...My gem, might we possibly indulge in that one human luxury– Hm, what was it called...? ...A bubble bath?$7#$b#Indeed, a bubble bath! With the accompaniment of yellow vinyl waterfowl - at least one, but preferably multiple.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_0: Having time to myself is yet another unfamiliar experience for me, but not a wholly unwelcome one.$8#$b#What shall I do to pass the time today? Hm... Perhaps I could try my hand at writing poetry of my own. For the font of inspiration within my heart springs eternal, so long as I am blessed with your love.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_1: Do you feel as if I spend enough time at home, my cherished? ...Or perhaps too much? Do you feel that I smother you?$s#$b#I beg your pardon... Since I have never had someone in my life so dear to my heart as you, @, I am unsure of how best to sate my desire for your companionship while also paying mind to your own needs.$s#$b#But simply say the word, and I shall give you all the space you wish...$4#$b#...Or lack thereof.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_2: I apologize, my flower, but I cannot accompany you on your travels today.#$b#It appears Gabriella has decided to focus the brunt of her power on seizing this land for herself today... I must remain here to guard it from her forces.$7#$b#Stay vigilant out there, my pearl.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_3: Oh, dearest - Could I trouble you to bring some cleaning supplies home from Pierre's, should today's errands take you into town?#$b#No, I am not "afraid" of him. I simply find him aggravating... Hmph.$7
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_4: Today's mission is of utmost import. My weapon: a lowly broom. The target: the heinous dust that doggedly besieges our floors. The goal: complete and utter eradication...$7#$b#I swear to you, my divinity, that I shall see this task to completion, no matter the cost I may bear.$7
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_Jio: I have excellent news to report, my sunbeam.$1#$b#After spending many hours conducting exhaustive research at the local library, and pouring through myriad books with alarming jello-casserole monstrosities on the covers, I believe I have finally acquired the skills to successfully prepare a variety of home-cooked dishes for our family.$8#$b#Here, my fairest - the result of this morning's trial run.[194 195 201 210 211 ]$1#$b#I would be honored if you would try a bite for me, and positively elated if you found its taste even remotely favorable.$l
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_0: I have not had much experience in household tasks before now, but I believe I have adapted to them most deftly.$1#$b#I stand ready to accept your critique, my star, should you wish to inspect my work.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_1: Having a house, yet alone maintaining one, is an altogether unfamiliar experience to an orphan such as myself...#$b#But the longer I'm here, the more I learn that the simple act of protecting and supporting a common place can in itself be an expression of affection.$8#$b#I hope that you can sense the love that I have scrubbed, mopped, and polished into every inch of our home, my blessing.$l
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_2: Behold, my flower. I have successfully prepared that which is second only to you in my heart - plum pudding.[604]$1#$b#Perhaps you might like to share it with me?$8
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_3: Are your muscles sore from work, beloved?#$b#Come, let me guide you through some effective stretches. It wouldn't do to have my honey bee injured, would it?$h#$e#Yes, you must remove your overclothes, but I swear to you I will not get distracted. Your health is far too important.$a
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_4: All day I have felt out of sorts - my nerves on edge, my thoughts muddled, my pulse haywire - and the reason has eluded me, until now...$7#$b#...I hunger for you, my fire. I need to pour over every inch of you with my hands, my eyes, my lips... This body will not let me rest till it is once again fused with yours, deep within...$l#$b#So take care of whatever duties you must attend to before bed, then come to our chambers. I'll be waiting, @.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_Jio: How was your day, my beloved? I want you to regale me with every last detail, no matter how quotidian. For there is nothing about you that does not fascinate me to my core.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_0: It's quite peculiar, my angel... All my life, I have been taught to constantly stay vigilant, always looking out for the next possible threat. And I had to, because there always was one.#$b#Thus, even when there were none, I could never let my senses take but a moment's rest, for such complacency was precisely the lapse in judgment that our enemies were waiting for.$7#$b#But right now, I know in my very soul, without a sliver of doubt, that nothing can bring us harm. I am perfectly at ease, here in this moment with you.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_1: Since marrying you, I have learned that the beauty of a place far transcends appearance alone. It is the love and care devoted to every inch of it that truly makes a place what it is. And this farm, our home, gains its splendor from the tireless hours of diligent work you spend on it every day, my sun.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_2: Though we may be equals in terms of our marital union, beholding the proficiency with which you tend to this land serves as a reminder to me that there are still many areas where you are the master and I am but your humble student.$h
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_3: Ah – please don't let me distract you from your work, my sky. I don't mean to be a nuisance.#$b#I simply wish to observe you for a short while, as you go about your morning. It makes me feel... at ease, I suppose.$l
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_4: I hope that my presence here brings you the same peace of mind it does me, my love.$8
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Jio.1: I'll be out on a mission today, my heaven.#$b#I should be back by nightfall, but should something delay me, I'll have Kiwi send word lest you worry excessively.#$b#I love you, dear. Stay safe for me, and I promise to do the same.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Jio.2: I've always recognized that the mission of the Cult is a noble one. Still...#$b#Knowing that my duties today will contribute not only to your own well-being, but also to those you hold dear, makes me feel as if I truly serve a purpose in this world.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Jio.3: I must depart for the day, my plum. Should you need anything at all, send word through Daia.#$b#Even if merely an errand you wish for me to run on the way home, do not hesitate to reach out – Is that understood?#$b#Stay safe, my love...$s
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Jio.4: If only the gears of time would cease for a moment and allow me but a day's respite... Alas, preserving the sanctity of this realm is no simple task.$s#$b#I will endeavor to restrain my longing for you until I return, so please endure it as well, my darling.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Jio.5: I know you are more than capable of protecting yourself and that I have nothing to fear during my absence, but all the same... Please stay safe while I'm away, my flower. For my own sake...$s
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Jio.1-1: On my way home from the base today, a thought suddenly crossed my mind – That with all you do for our family every day, without fail, perhaps I ought to try to ease the burden on my beloved's shoulders...$s#$b#So I ventured to the locals' favorite dining establishment – Pika's, as it were – and ordered this take-out item, so that I may spare you the task of preparing dinner.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Jio.1-2: I hope I was able to be of help, at least a little...$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Jio.2: Today's mission...? Ah, yes, it was most dreadful, my harmony... We– I–#$b#...Hm. Standing before you now, your hands intertwined with mine... I'm finding that I cannot recall the details of whatever made my day so horrible...$8#$b#In fact, I'd venture to say this day might still turn around for me yet...$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Jio.3: My love, I am ashamed to report that I sustained some minor injuries today - nothing that won't have healed in a week's time, but...$2#$b#Could you... kiss it and make it better...?$4#$b#...Ugh. I will never take advice from Daia again. All that did was add self-inflicted insult to injury...$7
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Jio.4: Embarrassed as I am... I must admit to you, my dearest, that I made a critical error during today's mission because I was thinking of you instead of focusing on the task at hand.$2#$b#Please chastise me appropriately...$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Jio.5: As promised, I endured my ardent longing for you throughout the day and completed my mission despite the difficulty.$1#$b#Perhaps such patience deserves a reward...?$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_0: To think that something so small and defenseless would be entrusted to my care... I still cannot fully comprehend it. But nonetheless... I am grateful.$l
Jio.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_1: I scoured Belinda's library collection for any writings on half-elves, but the literature appears to be scarce...$7#$b#Regardless, %kid1 should have a perfectly normal life ahead of them... Right, my love?$s
Jio.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_2: It amazes me every day that our love for one another could manifest itself physically – in the form of a life, no less.$l#$b#Despite all its ugliness, the beauty of life never ceases to take my breath away.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_3: I borrowed a book on parenting from the local library, and it suggested new parents put locks on any drawers or cabinets with dangerous items within. But surely a mere infant could not reach such heights so easily...?$7#$b#Anyway, love, I'm short one shuriken – You haven't happened to see it lying around, have you?#$b#...O-Oh dear Yoba – I'm precisely like Parent B!$6#$b#...Give me thirty minutes, and I'll have child locks on each and every crevice within these property lines.$7
Jio.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_0: Keeping an eye on both children at once is proving remarkably challenging.$7#$b#Do you suppose this might be the result of them emulating their father?$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_1: It still leaves me awestruck that we are the guardians of such small, precious lives.$ll#$b#It's such a small mission in the scope of this world... Yet, to me, they are the world.$l
Jio.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_2: Raising children occasionally reminds me of when Kiwi first came under my care.#$b#%kid1 and %kid2 share in her love of innocent mischief.$h
Jio.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_3: I have received a new set of locks from Bliss for my weapon cabinets.$1#$b#Now, let us see children best THESE...$7
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_0: @, come closer to me, my fire. I have not had my fill of you just yet... And you'll be staying by my side till I have.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_1: There is so much in this world that reminds me of you.$8#$b#The wind is the sound of your laugh, the sunlight is your eyes...$9#$b#I've been surrounded by nature all my life, but now that I have you, their meaning is utterly and permanently changed.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_2: I've never been one to believe in destiny – Such a concept seemed to only suit the heroes of fairy tales...#$b#So I don't know if every hardship in my life was a mere stepping stone on my inevitable path to our meeting. But here I am, all the same.#$b#And for that reason alone, I would endure it all again, exactly as it happened, lest I risk my chance at meeting my life's truest love – you.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_3: How is it that in my eyes, you are perfect no matter what you do?$9#$b#Every smudge of dirt, every misplaced lock of hair only adds to your natural beauty, my fairest.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_4: My missions in the Cult may have their purpose – but you, my blessing, give me purpose of my own.$9#$b#You've made me realize that there is more to living than merely acting in the name of some greater good.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_5-1: I had read about a mythical flower in Belinda's collection, but I had never in my days seen one with my own eyes...#$b#But at dawn today, as I watched this marvel of nature rise gingerly from the earth and unfurl its petals to the sun above...$8#$b#My heart instantly yearned to bestow such a miracle unto you, my flower, and see if its beauty might compare to yours.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_5-2: Naturally, there's not the slightest competition.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_6: Is that a cut on your arm, my angel? Come. I'll treat it for you...$s#$b#You must take better care of yourself, my beloved. This wound may be minor, but if something were to happen to you...$a#$b#Well, first I would see your health restored, of course – and promptly. But once you were well again... you would have me to deal with.$a
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_7: Sometimes I just wish to hold you, and feel the warmth of your skin on mine until the barriers between us have all but withered away...$9#$b#...But until then, perhaps it would suffice to remove these material barriers instead? Come, my fire, let me help you out of those clothes...$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_8: My treasure – If there's any way I can assist you in your tasks today, would you be kind enough to let me know? Not if it burdens you, of course, but...$s#$b#...I wish to assist you, somehow. To make your life easier, or more pleasant, perhaps. The way you do for me by simply existing beside me...$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_9: @... I love you, my blessing.$9#$b#I realized I rarely state it plainly to you... but in however many words, I mean it all the same.$9
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_0: Someone was prowling around in the early hours. I accosted them, but it seems it was only the mail carrier..#$b#...I shall leave them an apology note in the mailbox before the morning.$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_1: @! Excellent news, beloved – I have discovered a meal well-suited to the knife-handling skills I already possess. Would you care to try it?[227]$h
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_2: Is this "Lewis" character truly trustworthy? Skulking about in the early morning is only for those of the blade, not civilians like him...$7
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_3: I apologize if I am still getting used to some of the technology in your home.#$b#I will... try my best not to destroy any more of it.$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_4: I'm acquainted with that fortune teller on television. She drinks too much, but her predictions are more or less accurate.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_5: The civilians are all quite friendly with you, my beloved.$8#$b#...I hope my reputation as a strange mountain hermit does not damage your own.$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_6: %Jio yawns.#$b#Ah, my apologies. Gabriella had her minions mount an attempted trespassing at an unfortunate hour last night.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_7: My love, might you... show me your scars sometime?$4#$b#I wish to know about each of your run-ins with Death.$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_8: Today, I shall sample a new civilian food, in hopes that the experience may shed light its popularity. Would you like to share it with me?[206 211 213 223 224 233 253 346 395 648]$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_9: Most humans are unaware of the world's true nature – of magic and monsters and so on. I used to think them naive for it, but... perhaps their lives are better off that way.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_0: We come from different worlds, @... Maybe we should have stayed in them.$7
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_1: I don't understand you, @. You've changed.$7
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_2: If you are this bored with me, just let me go. There's no need to drag this out any further.$7
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_3: Did I err in choosing to trust you?$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_4: We've spent so much time together, come so far, and suddenly you've decided it's not worth continuing? Does your vow mean so little, @?$5
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_6: I hope Kiwi is alright without me...$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_7: %Jio seems on high alert, like he is expecting trouble.#$b#Don't disturb me.$5
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_8: The walls of this house are suffocating.$7
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_9: Do I even have a purpose here?$2
MapString.SpouseRoom.Alissa.0: Alissa's laptop. She uses it for recording songs, researching music, and playing solitaire.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Alissa.1: Alissa's keyboard. She says her parents gave it to her when she was a child, before they left.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Alissa.2: Alissa's song ideas.#She's written so many lyrics, the pages are spilling off her desk!
MapString.SpouseRoom.Alissa.3: A potted fiddlehead fig Alissa got from Kimpoi.#They're apparently difficult to keep alive, but this one looks to be putting out new leaves.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Anton.0: The Fundamentals of Architecture.#There are a couple notes inserted between the pages. Some look old and some look new.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Anton.1: An unfinished design of what looks like a mountainside lake house?
MapString.SpouseRoom.Anton.2: Anton's weekly to-do list.#It's full of unticked checkboxes.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Anton.3: Anton's drawer... It's a bit messy.#You find a post-it note with the text written: "Never give up! Make your loved ones proud!"
MapString.SpouseRoom.Blair.0: Blair's guppy Chika.#She said she named it that because "that guppy's a sassy one".
MapString.SpouseRoom.Blair.1: A plush doll of a blue junimo.#Blair said she loved reading about the fairytales of junimos and nature spirits when she was young.#Also, the blue reminded her of the water where she loves to fish.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Blair.2: There seems to be small animal figurines placed decoratively on the plant's soil.#Blair said Keahi and Trinnie gave those to her as gifts for her birthday.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Blair.3: This bag's full of Blair's fishing equipment, and some snacks.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Bryle.0: The radio's tuned in to the daily news updates.#There's also a paper taped beside it with a bunch of police scanner frequencies listed.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Bryle.1: Bryle's computer... It's password-protected.#The screensaver's a picture of your farm!
MapString.SpouseRoom.Bryle.2: A book titled 'Mysteries of Ferngill Republic'.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Bryle.3: A stack of papers about Bryle's security business.#Best to leave these alone.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Corine.0: Corine said Ysabelle gave this to her when they were younger.#There's something written in the tag - "We'll always be best friends forever!"
MapString.SpouseRoom.Corine.1: "Remember to drink lots of water and tell me if that partner of yours makes you angry. I'll handle 'em! -Love, Dad"
MapString.SpouseRoom.Corine.2: Corine should polish these - Daia told her to keep these boots 'neat and sexy'.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Corine.3: Both of these notes are in Corine's handwriting.#One has her weekly schedule for her waitressing shifts.#The other is a list of training tips from Jio and Daia.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Daia.0: "Long-term Relationships for Dummies"#There are sticky tabs on several pages.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Daia.1: All the tools and clothing needed for Daia's various missions.#Wait, why are there bunny ears in here...?
MapString.SpouseRoom.Daia.2: Daia says this sword is just for show, and that her real weapons are hidden elsewhere - though you're not exactly sure where...
MapString.SpouseRoom.Faye.0: An old sewing machine. Like, really old - Definitely older than Faye, and probably even older than her parents...#But apparently it's much more reliable than newer models, according to her.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Faye.1: A pile of unused yarn bits.#$b#Faye says all her excess yarn is a SABLE: Stash Accumulated Beyond Life Expectancy.#You can't really disagree...
MapString.SpouseRoom.Faye.2: A state-of-the-art loom, and a gift from Faye's parents. She taught herself how to use it with online videos.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Faye.3: Some snacks from Faye's emergency supply of munchies.#Hopefully her blood sugar didn't drop too low again...
MapString.SpouseRoom.Flor.0: "Daily to-do list: 1. Remember to kiss your partner good morning. 2. Remember to hug them tight before going to bed"#How cute!
MapString.SpouseRoom.Flor.1: "Nonverbal Communication: 104 Ways To Know If A Person Is Happy, Sad, Or Mad."
MapString.SpouseRoom.Flor.2: A giant stack of books.#Flor said these are all part of her related literature review for an upcoming research study.#Each one is full of color-coded bookmarks!
MapString.SpouseRoom.Flor.3: Flor said she wanted to learn how to farm, so you gave her this plant!#She's been studying how to properly care for it and watering it every day!
MapString.SpouseRoom.Ian.0: Ian made this table himself! It's really sturdy.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Ian.1: Ian has been using this to practice carving details.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Ian.2: A page with neatly printed letters. It begins, "Dear @"...#$b#You quickly stop reading.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Ian.3: Ian wanted to try growing something, so you got him this plant.#$b#It's doing really well!
MapString.SpouseRoom.Irene.0: There's a note here that reads:#"Langga, I know you can't resist my treats, but don't touch this yet! I still need to perfect them. -Love, Irene"#...Oh. Okay, then...
MapString.SpouseRoom.Irene.1: Irene keeps a coded copy of all her recipes in here.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Irene.2: There's something engraved on the corner. "Be proud of all you've accomplished. - Maive Amethyne."
MapString.SpouseRoom.Irene.3: Irene spends her free time talking to this plant.#It's cute that she believes talking to them helps them grow!
MapString.SpouseRoom.Jeric.0: A special gridball signed by a famous player.#Jeric mentioned once that this was a gift from Bryle from their teenage years.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Jeric.1: Jeric's regimen of skincare products. There sure are a lot of them...
MapString.SpouseRoom.Jeric.2: A collection of fashion magazines. There are some loose pages with outfit sketches, too.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Jeric.3: It's a letter addressed to Jeric from the governor.#Maybe you'll just put that back...
MapString.SpouseRoom.Jio.0: A notebook full of excerpts from poems. Here's one...#Love^Is a ripe plum^Growing on a purple tree.^Taste it once^And the spell of its enchantment^Will never let you be.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Jio.1: Jio uses this for his covert missions. You guess it must have stealth-boosting properties.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Jio.2: You're not sure what kinds of missions Jio uses this for, but he always seems particularly agitated when he returns from them.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Jio.3: Jio got this at Kiwi's insistence, so that he'd always have a reminder of her.
MapString.SpouseRoom.June.0: June said all this stray cat he took in does is sleep, but man, *all* she does is sleep...
MapString.SpouseRoom.June.1: A hot cup of coffee... You smell notes of wild berries, caramel, and cocoa.
MapString.SpouseRoom.June.2: A comic in a language you can't read... But the art suggests the story is about high school street cycling.
MapString.SpouseRoom.June.3: A cookbook with annotations scribbled all throughout the margins.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Kenneth.0: An extremely old computer. Kenneth called it a dinosaur.#Apparently he wants to try to restore it back to function.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Kenneth.1: A microwave Kenneth's been trying to "upgrade".#He wants to give it a "voice activation function" or something.#He said progress has been... disappointing.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Kenneth.2: Yet another computer!#The wallpaper is a blurry picture he took of you watering your crops.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Kenneth.3: A half-eaten serving of fries.#Kenneth said not to throw it out because he's saving the leftovers for later.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Kiarra.0: Kiarra's bookshelf.  Her reference books are in easy reach, while her spicy gay romance books are nestled toward the far side.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Kiarra.1: Kiarra's work tablet. You pause to admire her latest project.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Kiarra.2: A strongly worded letter to a local politician regarding a recent bill.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Kiarra.3: Some notes for various projects. They're more chaotic than you would expect.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Maddie.0: Maddie's dollhouse. Every once in a while she spends hours rearranging the contents and taking pictures.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Maddie.1: Maddie's pet fish. She said Aguar gave it to her for some home studies.#You suspect he just wanted her to have a pretty fish.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Maddie.2: A plush bear. Maddie says it was a gift, and refuses to elaborate further.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Maddie.3: You got this for Maddie! She likes to sit on it while she's reading.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Paula.0: A collection of books related to the medical field.#They have a bunch of colorful bookmarks in them.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Paula.1: You peer over at the open book on the table - it's a recent medical journal.#Paula said lately there's been a lot new research about a rare medicinal herb that can be useful for stopping excess blood loss in emergency situations.#The illustration of a blueish-purple flower looks vaguely familiar to you...
MapString.SpouseRoom.Paula.2: A dumbbell, and above it, a diagram illustrating various freeweight and bodyweight exercises.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Paula.3: A rolled-up yoga mat. Paula always takes the time to neatly store her exercise equipment every after use.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Philip.0: An old guitar.#Philip says he's been trying to learn the opening theme from his favorite show.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Philip.1: A collection of various comic books and action figures.#Some of the action figures are still in their boxes.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Philip.2: A dumbbell, and above it, a poster of a comic book-style drawing of a cityscape.#Philip says he stares at this poster while he exercises because it makes him feel like a superhero preparing to fight the next bad guy.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Philip.3: A stack of books all relating to physical rehabilitation sciences.#One is titled, "Kinesiology 101"... Another, "Orthosis and Prosthesis Rehabilitation".#...And an IncrediMan comic book at the very bottom.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Sean.0: A dumbbell. Sean usually gets bored with straight reps, so he's usually using this to fool around or play games with.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Sean.1: Sean once said this plant was unkillable. Given how he occasionally forgets it even exists, you're starting to believe him.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Sean.2: ...Note to self: remind Sean to return Philip's comic.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Shiro.0: Shiro said he's been interested in taking care of plants ever since he first saw the farm.#And now he's taking care of these plants diligently!
MapString.SpouseRoom.Shiro.1: An assortment of letters from Shiro's father Shoto.#It's best not to open them.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Shiro.2: Shiro's clothes. They're very neatly organized!
MapString.SpouseRoom.Shiro.3: This drawer has a bunch of Shiro's personal stuff stored in it.#There's a picture of Shiro and his military friends in the field. He has a big goofy smile in it.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Ysabelle.0: A vanity, gifted to Ysa by Richard.#Apparently, Ysa had a smaller version of this when she was younger she got from her grandmother Angelica.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Ysabelle.1: A dumbbell - Because even dancers have to keep their strength up, right?
MapString.SpouseRoom.Ysabelle.2: Ysa says she has always been fond of stuffed animals, with this one in particular being her favorite. She named him Pepito.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Zayne.0: ...Wow, even Zayne's bookshelf has the Amethyne family crest engraved on the borders.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Zayne.1: Zayne's tablet.#It's open on a presentation titled, "Amethyne Corp.: Culture and Business growing hand in hand."
MapString.SpouseRoom.Zayne.2: Zayne's personal cell, in its charging port.#There's a text notification from one "Grandmother" that reads, "As soon as you've had a word with your Father, come to the mansion."
MapString.SpouseRoom.Zayne.3: A book, open to a passage that reads, "Thy unending love shall pass through great challenges every morn."
